gm.title: Description
lines: This carved guardian watches its assigned building from the eaves.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Initiative +5. AC +1 Dex, +11 natural. Touch AC 11, flat-footed AC 21. Base attack +8, grapple +16. Space 5 ft., reach 5 ft. Fort +3, Ref +2, Will +3.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack. Slam +8 melee for 2d6 + 8. Full attack makes two slams at the same bonus and damage.
Pounce (Ex). On the first round of combat, make one slam against a creature within 100 ft. If it hits after leaping down, add the falling damage the golem would have taken. Divide that extra damage between the target and their armor, shield or weapon, prioritizing items in that order.
Petrify (Su). A target hit by both slams in the same round must succeed on a DC 15 Fortitude save or turn to stone. The golem attempts a coup de grace against the statue the next round. If the target dies, only true resurrection, wish or miracle can restore it.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Damage reduction 10/magic. Immune to falling damage.
Magic Immunity (Ex). Immune to spells, spell-like abilities and supernatural effects, with named exceptions. Soften earth and stone deals 2d8 damage without a save. Earthquake targeted on the golem destroys it. A targeted dispel magic at DC 16 disables it for a number of rounds equal to the caster's dispel check result minus 10. A result at least 10 above the DC destroys it. Detect magic reveals its aura returning while it is disabled.
Construct traits. Immune to mind-affecting effects, poison, disease and similar effects. Critical hits, nonlethal damage, ability damage, energy drain and death from massive damage do not affect it, subject to the exceptions below.

gm.title: Dread golem commands
lines: The creator can give commands from within 60 ft. if the golem can see and hear them. It follows the last command and responds to attacks against it. Some dread golems act independently.

gm.title: Skills and feats
lines: Climb +13, Hide +6, Jump +13, Listen +5. Improved Initiative, Power Attack.

gm.title: Encounter details
lines: Any land or underground. Solitary, always neutral, no treasure. Advances to 11–15 HD (Medium) or 16–25 HD (Large).

gm.title: Table notes
lines: The printed +8 melee slam is lower than its base attack plus Strength. Use the printed attack line. The pounce rules do not give an exact division of extra falling damage.

gm.title: Portrait reference
lines: Original interpretation based on Kobold Press’s public creature listing.

gm.title: Description
lines: A sentient white rose bush senses visitors through scent and empathy. It gives up one flower a week to protect someone from the Red Curse.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Rare, solitary, active by day in forest. Chaotic good. Intelligence 5–7. Steady morale 11–12. No treasure or magic resistance.

gm.title: Actions
lines: The bush has no normal attack. It uses its Legacies if someone uproots it or takes a second rose within a week. Its song can charm monsters within 1 mile and turn them against its foes.

gm.title: Defensive Legacies
lines: Acid Touch deals 1d4 plus 1 per HD on a hit. Entangle creates tentacles 5 feet long per 3 HD, to a maximum of 25 feet, for 1 round per level. An entangled target needs a successful bend bars roll to escape. Poison adds 1d6 damage to a natural physical attack other than a bite and can also cause sleep, paralysis, damage or death depending on HD. A save vs. poison halves the effect. Weaken reaches 10 yards. On a failed save vs. spell, the target counts as Strength 5 and takes −2 to attacks and −1 per damage die for 1 round per level.

gm.title: Plucked rose
lines: The flower protects as one ounce of cinnabryl. Its last petal drops at the end of day seven. The bearer cannot use Legacies while protected by the rose.

gm.title: Experience
lines: Award 35 XP once for encountering the bush or using a rose. Destroying the bush earns no XP.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: The appendix gives the song a 1-mile radius without specifying a save, duration or use limit. Its generic Poison rule lists possible effects by HD without giving a full tier table.

gm.title: Description
lines: A fiendish hound said to descend from Hel’s own. Its howl can shake stone and help it corner prey underground.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Natural armor. Perception 17, Stealth 12. Immune to necrotic and poison damage, Exhaustion, Paralyzed, and Poisoned. Darkvision 60 ft. Understands Infernal without speaking. Telepathy 60 ft.

gm.title: Ability modifiers
lines: Str +4, Dex +2, Con +3, Int -1, Wis +3, Cha -1

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Maggoty Hide. When a creature within 5 ft. makes a melee attack against the garmr, it makes a DC 13 Dexterity save. If it fails, maggots infest it for 3 (1d6) necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns to end the infestation. Taking at least 5 acid or fire damage also destroys the maggots. After the creature saves or the maggots are destroyed, it is immune to this trait for 1 hour.
Pack Tactics. Has advantage on an attack if an ally within 5 ft. of the target is not Incapacitated.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Bite attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.
Earth Rending Howl (Recharge 6). Each creature in a 20-ft. cone makes a DC 13 Strength save. Failure deals 17 (5d6) thunder damage and makes it Deafened for 1 minute. Success halves the damage and avoids the condition. Unattended objects and structures take double damage with no save or damage threshold.

gm.title: Bonus Actions
lines: Rotten Shake (Recharge 5–6). Each creature within 5 ft. makes a DC 13 Dexterity save or suffers Maggoty Hide.

gm.title: Reading Black Flag stat blocks
lines:
Rules source. Black Flag Reference Document, Monsters.
The printed modifiers and fixed HP are ready to use. For a Dexterity (Stealth) check to avoid the creature, use its Perception value as the DC. For a Wisdom (Perception) check to detect it, use its Stealth value as the DC.
Condition resistance gives advantage on checks and saves to avoid or end the named condition. Condition vulnerability gives disadvantage. Apply damage resistance and vulnerability to the amount of damage instead.

gm.title: Description
lines: The common geist cannot manifest in the material world. Instead it shows witnesses a false image of itself or draws them into an impression of the past.

gm.title: Classification
lines: Medium undead (augmented humanoid, incorporeal), 2nd-level human commoner example

gm.title: Actions
lines:
No weapon or natural attack.
Mind Games (Su). As a free action, show a self-image to living creatures within 30 ft. Use major image except the image is a phantasm. DC 10 Will to avoid perceiving it. The GM may call for a Horror save if the geist died a gruesome death.
Phantom Shift (Su). Target a living creature and replace its perception of the Material Plane with the area’s ethereal resonance. DC 10 Will negates. The geist often recreates the circumstances of its death.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Incorporeal and undead traits. The geist cannot manifest and ignores damage from corporeal sources. Destroying it temporarily does not end the haunting; it returns until its unfinished business is laid to rest. A bound geist has +4 turn resistance and cowers rather than leaving its site if turned.

gm.title: Combat statistics
lines: Initiative +2. AC +2 Dex, touch 12, flat-footed 10. Printed BAB/grapple +1/+1, space/reach 5 ft./5 ft. Fort +0, Ref +2, Will +0.

gm.title: Skills and feats
lines: Hide +10, Listen +10, Profession +7, Search +8, Spot +11. Lightning Reflexes, Skill Focus (Profession). Solitary, gang of 2–4 or mob of 7–12, any alignment and no treasure.

gm.title: Applying the encounter template
lines: Choose a base creature with Charisma at least 6 from aberration, animal, dragon, giant, humanoid, magical beast, monstrous humanoid or shapechanger. Its type becomes undead with the incorporeal subtype. Keep size, saves and applicable base statistics, but remove prior attacks and special abilities, Strength and Constitution. HD becomes d12; Charisma rises by 2; fly 30 ft. perfect or keep a higher fly speed. Natural armor applies only to ethereal encounters. Add +8 racial bonuses to Hide, Listen, Search and Spot. The listed common geist uses Mind Games and Phantom Shift. CR 1/2; ability DC equals 10 + half HD + Cha modifier.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: The printed sample lists a grapple modifier despite its incorporeal subtype. It has no physical attacks.

gm.title: MCDM minion rules
lines:
Minions of the same stat block normally share a turn and can all move before taking their actions. They use fixed damage, cannot score critical hits, and have no Hit Dice to spend.
A minion drops to 0 HP if an attack damages it or it takes damage from failing a save. Other damage kills it if the damage meets or exceeds its maximum HP. Otherwise the minion ignores that damage.
Overkill. When a weapon hit deals more damage than a minion’s maximum HP, apply the excess to an additional minion of the same stat block, as weapon attack damage. Repeat while damage remains after subtracting each target’s maximum HP. Melee targets must be within reach of the attack. Ranged targets must lie along the line of the attack and within the weapon’s normal range. Opportunity attacks cannot overkill.
Group attack. Two to five minions of the same stat block sharing a turn can each spend their action to make one attack if the target is within reach or range of each participant. Roll once, adding +1 for each participant, and multiply the fixed damage by that same count on a hit. Use advantage or disadvantage only if it applies to everyone in the group. Split groups when the target has different cover or concealment from different attackers.
A minion can make a group attack alone using its listed attack bonus and damage. If multiple eligible minions could make the same melee opportunity attack, they can each use their reaction to join one group attack. If the group attack triggers an effect against a single attacker, its target chooses which participating minion it affects.

lines:
Undead traits and +2 turn resistance.
Miasma (Su). Good-aligned creatures within 60 ft. make a DC 14 Will save or suffer a −4 morale penalty on attacks, checks, and saves until they leave the radius. This is a fear effect.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack. Bite +8 melee for 1d6 + 2.
Full attack. Bite +8 melee for 1d6 + 2 and two claws +10 melee for 1d4 + 4 each. Alternatively, use the masterwork bastard sword +14 melee for 1d10 + 8 or the masterwork shortbow +10 ranged for 1d6. The bite carries paralysis and fever, and the claws carry paralysis.
Paralysis (Su). A bite or claw hit requires a DC 14 Fortitude save or paralysis lasts 1d6 + 6 minutes.
Create Spawn (Su). A humanoid or monstrous humanoid killed by fever at Constitution 0 rises as a ghoul lord after 24 hours if the body has not been destroyed. Someone slain directly by a bite or claw rises as a ghast after 1d4 days. Spawn serve their creator until it dies.

gm.title: Ravenous fever
lines: A bite can spread this supernatural disease. Fortitude DC 20, incubation 1d4 days, damage 1d4 Constitution. Once infected, a victim needs raw flesh daily. The amounts in pounds, Fine through Colossal, are 1/8, 1/4, 1/2, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, and 32. After more than 2 Constitution damage from the disease only humanoid flesh suffices. After more than 5 only flesh from living humanoids suffices. Going hungry for a day deals 1d4 temporary Constitution damage and calls for a Madness save, DC 10 + the Constitution damage suffered. Failure temporarily compels the victim to try to feed. Only heal cures the disease.

gm.title: Adapting the encounter
lines: For a different humanoid or monstrous humanoid base, change its type to undead, keep size, speed, and saves, convert current and future Hit Dice to d12, and add +4 natural armor. A base creature with a swim speed retains it and is called a lacedon lord. Keep base attacks and add missing claws and bite. Base bite/claw damage by size, Fine to Colossal: 1/none, 1d2/1, 1d3/1d2, 1d4/1d3, 1d6/1d4, 1d8/1d6, 2d6/2d4, 2d8/2d6, 4d6/2d8. Use better existing natural damage if applicable. Str +2, Dex +4, Int +2, Wis +2, Cha +4. Remove Con. Add Multiattack and +8 racial bonuses to Hide, Listen, Move Silently, Search, and Spot. CR increases by 2. Miasma and paralysis DCs are 10 + half HD + Cha modifier.

gm.title: Traits
lines:

Hungry Dead Nature. The ghoul needs no air or sleep. If it goes 24 hours without eating 2 lb. of raw meat, it loses Exhaustion immunity and risks starvation until it eats that amount. If starvation has already given it Exhaustion, it cannot remove those levels until it eats at least 4 lb. of raw meat.
Phosphorescent. Invisible in bright light. Stealth 10 in dim light or darkness.
Spider Climb. Climb difficult surfaces and ceilings without an ability check.
Undead Resilience. Immune to poison damage, Exhaustion, and Poisoned.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and two Claw attacks. When the Bite and at least one Claw hit the same target other than a Construct or Undead, that target makes a DC 14 Constitution save or contracts Ghoul Hunger.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 5 (2d4) radiant damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage plus 5 (2d4) radiant damage. A creature other than a Construct or Undead also makes a DC 14 Constitution save or is Poisoned for 1 minute. While Poisoned by this attack, it takes 2 (1d4) radiant damage at the start of each turn. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns to end the effect.

gm.title: Bonus Actions
lines: Startling Lunge. Choose a visible creature within 15 ft. and move up to 15 ft. toward it without provoking opportunity attacks. If the ghoul moves within 5 ft. of the target, it makes a DC 14 Wisdom save. Failure gives the ghoul advantage on its next attack roll against that target before the end of the ghoul’s next turn.

gm.title: Ghoul Hunger
lines: The Block references the Monster Vault sidebar. As a table fallback, the published Black Flag Roleplaying Reference Document v0.1 disease makes the infected creature Poisoned until cured. Eating any Humanoid flesh suppresses that condition for 1 hour. Every 12 hours, make a DC 13 Constitution save with disadvantage if the creature ate Humanoid flesh while infected. Failure lowers maximum HP by 7 (2d6) until a long rest after the cure, and maximum HP 0 kills it. Two successful saves cure the disease. After two failures or death while infected, it becomes a ghoul, or an ashrat if its proficiency bonus is +4 or higher. Wish or magic of similar strength can undo the transformation.

gm.title: Description
lines: Jotun claim the oldest mountain and glacier halls in the North. The giants keep secrets from before the present age and plot against the gods who displaced them.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Natural armor. Perception 15, Stealth 16. Immune to cold and to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks. Darkvision 120 ft. Languages Common and Giant.

gm.title: Ability modifiers
lines: Str +14, Dex -1, Con +13, Int +4, Wis +12, Cha +9

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Giant Attributes. Resistant to Stunned and vulnerable to Prone. It has advantage on checks and saves to avoid or end Stunned, and disadvantage on checks and saves to avoid or end Prone.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). Turn a failed save into a success.
Magic Resistance. The jotun has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Material Bound. Effects cannot force the jotun off the Material Plane against its will. It has disadvantage on saves against effects that would return it there from another plane.
Too Big to Notice. Stealth becomes 21 while the jotun holds still in nonmagical natural terrain.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make three attacks using Greatclub or Rock in any combination. One can be replaced with Icy Sweep or a casting of Fear.
Greatclub. Melee weapon attack, +14 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit 25 (4d8 + 7) bludgeoning and 36 (8d8) cold damage.
Rock. Ranged weapon attack, +14 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit 29 (4d10 + 7) bludgeoning and 36 (8d8) cold damage.
Icy Sweep (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 20-ft. radius centered on the jotun makes a DC 21 Dexterity save. On a failure, it takes 54 (12d8) cold damage, is pushed up to 15 ft. away, and falls Prone. On a success, it takes half damage and stays in place on its feet.
Spellcasting. Wisdom (spell save DC 20), no material components. At will: Bestow Curse, Earthquake, Fear, Gust of Wind, and Speak with Animals.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Rock Catching. When a ranged weapon attack hits the jotun, it can catch the weapon or ammunition to reduce the attack’s damage by 38 (1d20 + 28). If this brings the damage to zero, it can throw what it caught at a creature within 60 ft., using the original attack roll and damage.

gm.title: Legendary Actions
lines:
The jotun has three legendary actions. It can use one option at the end of another creature’s turn and regains spent actions at the start of its turn.
Hurl. Make one Rock attack.
Smash. Make one Greatclub attack.
Titanic Power. Use Spellcasting or an available Icy Sweep.

On a failure, for up to 1 minute with Concentration its only actions are unintelligible cries. gm.title: MCDM minion rules
lines:
Minions of the same stat block normally share a turn and can all move before taking their actions. They use fixed damage, cannot score critical hits, and have no Hit Dice to spend.
A minion drops to 0 HP if an attack damages it or it takes damage from failing a save. Other damage kills it if the damage meets or exceeds its maximum HP. Otherwise the minion ignores that damage.
Overkill. When a weapon hit deals more damage than a minion’s maximum HP, apply the excess to an additional minion of the same stat block, as weapon attack damage. Repeat while damage remains after subtracting each target’s maximum HP. Melee targets must be within reach of the attack. Ranged targets must lie along the line of the attack and within the weapon’s normal range. Opportunity attacks cannot overkill.
Group attack. Two to five minions of the same stat block sharing a turn can each spend their action to make one attack if the target is within reach or range of each participant. Roll once, adding +1 for each participant, and multiply the fixed damage by that same count on a hit. Use advantage or disadvantage only if it applies to everyone in the group. Split groups when the target has different cover or concealment from different attackers.
A minion can make a group attack alone using its listed attack bonus and damage. If multiple eligible minions could make the same melee opportunity attack, they can each use their reaction to join one group attack. If the group attack triggers an effect against a single attacker, its target chooses which participating minion it affects.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack or full attack. Choose slam +2 melee (1d4 − 1 and 1d4 permanent Dexterity drain to a living target), dagger +2 melee (1d4 − 1), or +1 light crossbow +9 ranged (1d8, 19–20/×2).
Mocking Grin (Su). Once per 10 minutes, standard action. Anyone within 30 ft. who sees its face makes a DC 13 Will save or suffers hideous laughter for 1d6 rounds as if cast at level 12. Different creature types get no save bonus. The fledgling deals 1d4 damage each round they laugh.
Animal Domination (Su). Standard action on an animal within 30 ft. that the vampire can look at. Will DC 13 or fall under domination as dominate person at caster level 12.
Blood Drain (Ex). Pin a living target in a grapple. Each round the pin holds, drain 1d4 Constitution and gain 5 temporary HP.
Disguise Self (Sp). At will as a standard action, caster level 12, with indefinite duration. Innate spell-like ability saves use 11 + spell level.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines: Printed slots 5/5/4/3 at levels 0–3, DC 14 + spell level. 0: dancing lights, detect magic, ghost sound, mage hand, prestidigitation. 1: color spray, feather fall, magic missile, unseen servant, ventriloquism. 2: glitterdust, hypnotic pattern, levitate, mirror image. 3: displacement, invisibility sphere, stinking cloud. It is mute and must use Silent Spell for spells with verbal components. Its printed gear includes a wand of burning hands and potions of cat’s grace and invisibility.

gm.title: Traits
lines: DR 10/silver and magic, resistance 20 to cold, electricity and fire, fast healing 3, turn resistance +4, rat familiar, undead traits. Metal weapons pass through it. Extra damage from a magical weapon, such as fire, can still hurt it. Automatically disbelieves illusions. Spider climb works only on inorganic surfaces. Spectral Form is a standard action. It becomes an incorporeal light indefinitely and flies 20 ft. (perfect), but cannot cross force effects, living creatures, or once-living material.

gm.title: Spawn
lines: It creates no vampire spawn. To create a gnomish vampire, drain a gnome with 5 HD or more to Constitution 0 or less and lie over the corpse in its own sarcophagus for three full days without leaving. The new vampire remains controlled until its creator dies.

gm.title: Repelling and slaying
lines: Silver-backed mirrors and clearly presented holy symbols repel it. A displayed jewel forces a Will save against the presenter’s Charisma check or it stares for 2d4 rounds. An attack ends this immediately. It cannot enter a building until it knocks once and a living creature answers. At 0 HP it escapes in spectral form, reaching its coffin within 2 hours or dying. After 1 hour inside it reaches 1 HP and resumes fast healing. Direct sunlight destroys it unless it escapes in a single standard action. A silver spike through the heart kills it while left in place. The book gives a burial ritual requiring its hands boiled for 24 hours in a volcanic spring and its eyes replaced with gems worth at least 100 gp each before sealing its masterwork wooden coffin.

lines: A small goblin minion carrying a dagger and a light shield.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Senses: darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 9. Languages: Common and Goblin.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Crafty. Leaving an enemy's reach doesn't trigger an opportunity attack.
Minion. Any attack or failed save that deals damage drops the lackey to 0 HP. Other damage kills it if the amount reaches 6 HP. Otherwise it ignores that damage.
Tiny Stabs. If an enemy begins its turn within 5 ft. of at least three lackeys who can see it, it must save Dexterity against DC 10 plus the number of lackeys within 5 ft. Failure deals 1 piercing damage per nearby lackey.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Dagger (group attack). Melee or ranged weapon attack +3, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage.

gm.title: Minion rules
lines:
Group attack. Two to five lackeys sharing a turn can each spend their action to attack a target in reach or range of each of them. Make one attack at +3 plus the number of participants. On a hit, deal 1 piercing damage per participant. A lone lackey uses +3. Advantage or disadvantage applies to the group roll only if every participant has it. If the target has different cover or concealment against some attackers, split them into groups and roll separately.
Group opportunity attack. If a creature provokes from multiple lackeys at once, each may spend its reaction to join. Lackeys cannot score critical hits. If a response to the attack can affect only one attacker, the target chooses which participant it affects.
Overkill. A weapon hit dealing more than 6 damage leaves a surplus equal to the damage minus 6. Drop one eligible lackey for each 6 surplus damage or fraction thereof. Melee targets must be in reach of the weapon. Ranged targets must be on the line from the attacker through the original target and within the weapon's short range. This rule excludes opportunity attacks.

gm.title: Aelder
lines: Lesser golem. AC 3, 9 HD, 60 HP, THAC0 11, movement 18, 2,000 XP. Two piercing front-leg strikes for 2d6 each reach 10 feet. In icy burial grounds, ranged attacks beyond 20 feet are impossible and nonmelee attacks within 20 feet take −2. Immune to light or gaze effects. gm.title: Glassine Horror
lines: Lesser golem. AC 2, 8 HD, 60 HP, THAC0 13, movement 9, fly 36, 4,000 XP. As an inactive sheet, it occupies 50–100 square feet across a window or doorway and is 1–6 inches thick. As a roughly 15-foot humanoid, it punches once for 2d10. Opponents within 10 feet save vs. spell or take −2 to attacks. It can use crystalbrittle, sunburst as a wand of illumination, and continual light in this form. It is immune to light and electricity spells while humanoid. In sand form it moves at 36, at most 5 feet above a surface. The 100-cubic-foot cloud deals 2d8 to a creature on a successful attack roll and blinds it for 2d4 turns on a failed save vs. spell. The cloud is immune to wind spells. It flees below 10% of starting HP and heals by resting or absorbing 50 gp in gems per HP. Usually alone or 1d6 under its creator’s command. Lawful neutral, average morale 8–10, treasure Q ×4. No magic resistance.

gm.title: Red Golem
lines: Greater golem. AC 1, 18 HD, 90 HP, THAC0 3, movement 6, 14,000 XP. Two punches for 2d12 each. Both must target the same foe while that foe is still standing. It attacks the greatest threat first. Cinnabryl within 10 feet loses 1 ounce each round without triggering the Time of Loss and Change. It requires a +2 weapon to hit and takes half weapon damage from enchantments below +4. Magical electricity slows it for 1d3 rounds. Magical fire heals 1 HP per damage die. Other spells fail against it. It uses taunt after a strike with a nonmagical weapon or a spell it is immune to. It can alter its size and appearance with shapechange only on its master’s command. Large, neutral, fearless 19–20. No magic resistance or treasure.

gm.title: Hulean Juggernaut
lines: Greater golem. AC 0, 30 HD, 150 HP, movement 9, 21,000 XP. Creatures in its path save vs. breath weapon to escape sideways or take 10d10 damage. Its wheelbase can crush multiple targets at once. A ram may break larger obstacles, and soldiers aboard can attack creatures that evade the wheels. It can stop, turn or reverse within one round. Immune to fire, sleep, charm, hold and nonmagical weapons. All its saves succeed on 4 or higher. It obeys only its creator’s simple verbal commands and may keep following the last order after the creator dies. Only the creator can authorize entry. Gargantuan, neutral, elite morale 13–14, treasure A and possible extras. No magic resistance.

lines:
Medium elemental (Earth, Mists). CR 3. 30 HP (4d8 + 12). Initiative −1. Speed 20 ft..
AC 18, touch 9, flat-footed 18. Base attack +3, grapple +8. Space 5 ft., reach 5 ft.
Attack Slam +8 melee (1d8 + 7). Full attack Slam +8 melee (1d8 + 7).
Fort +7, Ref +0, Will +1. Str 21, Dex 8, Con 17, Int 5, Wis 11, Cha 11. Listen +4, Spot +3.
Feats include Cleave, Power Attack. Advancement 5–7 HD, Medium.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Slam. Make one melee slam, or use the full-attack count in the chosen tier.
Earth Mastery (Ex). Gain +1 to attack and damage while both the elemental and its opponent touch the ground. Against a foe in the air or water, apply −4 instead. The attack lines do not include these modifiers.
Sink (Su, once per hour). Choose one opponent within 60 ft. who is standing on earth or stone. The target makes an opposed grapple check against the elemental. On failure, spectral arms hold it in place. A Medium target sinks to its knees in round 1 and cannot leave its square. If the elemental keeps concentrating, the target sinks to its waist in round 2 and loses its Dexterity bonus to AC. In round 3 it is pulled 6 ft. underground and stays in suspended animation until unearthed. Allies can attempt the 3.5 break another’s pin action to free it before burial.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Darkvision 60 ft. Immune to poison, sleep, paralysis, stunning, critical hits, and flanking. Does not eat, sleep, or breathe. It cannot be raised or resurrected, though limited wish, wish, miracle, or true resurrection can restore it. Moves through earth and stone and senses groundborne movement with tremorsense. It cannot travel through or across water.

lines: Solitary, always neutral evil, no treasure. May appear in any environment.

gm.title: Dread elemental rules
lines:
Printed source. Elemental, Dread, p. 63, and Mists subtype, pp. 7–8.
In Ravenloft, calling a standard elemental has a 20% chance of producing a dread elemental. Summoning magic always produces the dread form. Accidental dread elementals are uncontrolled, and the Dark Powers supply the matching materials. Intentional conjuring requires the matching material and uses the usual chance for the elemental to break control.
Dread elementals understand speech but do not communicate. Their Mists subtype makes them native throughout Ravenloft and allows them to be summoned in any domain. A dismissed dread elemental returns to Ravenloft itself, so the realm's restrictions on calling do not break the calling pact.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: The Large table prints DR 10/+1. A weapon with at least a +1 enhancement bypasses it. Huge, Greater, and Elder use the printed DR 10/—.
The book gives no tremorsense distance. Use 60 ft. as a table default. Sink explicitly gives its round-by-round effects for a Medium target only.

gm.title: Description
lines: This bone-flecked ooze tunnels into graves for the bodies. Disturbing it can leave a living intruder trapped in the same grave.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Land and underground, especially graves. Solitary. Always neutral. Standard treasure. Advancement 7–9 HD (Large), 10–18 HD (Huge).

gm.title: Combat statistics
lines: Initiative −5. AC includes −1 size and −5 Dex, touch and flat-footed 4. Base attack +4, grapple +10. Printed space and reach 5 ft. each. Fort +4, Ref −3, Will −3. No skills or feats.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Ooze traits. Immune to necromantic effects and piercing damage. Blindsight detects heat and motion within 60 ft., and the ooze smells rotting flesh through the earth from miles away. Its acid dissolves only organic material.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack or full attack. Slam +5 melee (2d4 + 3 plus 1d4 acid).
Improved Grab (Ex). After a slam hits, attempt a grapple without provoking an attack of opportunity.
Engulf (Ex). On a successful grapple check against a Medium or smaller creature, engulf it or drag it into the grave. Each engulfed victim is trapped, takes acid damage automatically each round, and is exposed to contact poison. Halve damage from attacks against the engulfing ooze and apply the other half to the victim.
Poison (Ex). Fort DC 15, Constitution-based. Both initial and secondary damage are 1d4 Str and 1d4 Con.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: The book says Engulf deals acid damage but gives no separate amount. Use the slam’s 1d4 acid per round as a table default.

gm.title: Description
lines: An active grave scarab hunts warm flesh. A dormant survivor in a sealed tomb takes on a golden finish and can pass for jewelry until body heat wakes it.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Desert and underground. Solitary or swarm of 10–100. Always neutral. No treasure, advancement, or level adjustment.

gm.title: Combat statistics
lines: Initiative +2. Touch AC 20, flat-footed 22. Base attack +0, grapple −15. Space 1/2 ft., reach 0 ft. Fort +2, Ref +2, Will +0.

gm.title: Skills and feats
lines: Climb +2, Hide +10, Listen +2, Spot +1. Weapon Finesse (bonus).

gm.title: Traits
lines: Tremorsense and vermin traits. The sense has no listed range. It attacks the closest food and can be lured away with another food source.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack or full attack. Bite +10 melee (1d2 − 5, minimum 1 on a hit) plus flesh burrow.
Flesh Burrow (Ex). It travels along armor or similar material until it can reach bare skin. A successful attack roll lets it burrow toward the heart, dealing 1d4 hit point damage per round. It reaches the heart in 2 rounds for a Small target, 3 for Medium, or 4 for Large. Once there it inflicts 1d4 permanent Constitution damage each round. Creatures immune to critical hits are immune to this attack.
Removal. Cutting off the affected limb removes it. Attacks against a buried beetle target it without its Dexterity bonus and split damage evenly between beetle and host. A host attacking the beetle inside their own body takes −2 to attack and damage rolls.

gm.title: Description
lines: An ash-colored dream creature impersonates animals and bystanders. It flees if its disguise fails.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Initiative +0. AC 14 (+1 size, +3 natural), touch 11, flat-footed 14. Base attack +3, grapple +0. Space and reach 5 ft. Fort +4, Ref +3, Will +4.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack. Claw +5 melee (1d3+1). Full attack. Two claws +5 melee (1d3+1 each).
Lullaby (Su). As a standard action, opponents within 20 ft. must make a DC 14 Will save. Failure fatigues them for 1d4 rounds or as long as the dream spawn keeps speaking within 20 ft. of them. Maintaining the lullaby is a free action. This is a sonic, mind-affecting compulsion.
Memory Drain (Su, 1/day). A successful touch attack deals 1d4 Intelligence damage. Until the victim recovers all of those points, the dream spawn can use Alternate Form to impersonate any creature from the victim's memory.
Alternate Form (Su). Use polymorph on itself as a standard action at caster level 8. The form can last indefinitely. Returning to its own shape is a free action.

gm.title: Traits
lines: DR 5/magic. Darkvision 60 ft. It does not need to eat, drink, or breathe. Detect Thoughts (Su). In an inhabited dreamscape, it knows a creature's surface thoughts as though it had studied them for three rounds with detect thoughts, caster level 3, Will DC 13. Fear Eater (Ex). Immune to Fear, Horror, and Madness. A spell targeting it that would normally cause one of those effects heals 1 HP per spell level. When one of its actions makes a dreamer fail a Fear, Horror, or Madness save, it heals 2 HP for a minor outcome, 4 HP for a moderate outcome, or 8 HP for a major outcome.

gm.title: Dream defeat
lines: A dreamer killed by this dream spawn takes a DC 12 Ravenloft Madness save on waking (Will). For consequences and recovery, use the Ravenloft Player’s Handbook, chapter 3. A spawn that wins often returns to terrorize that dreamer again.

gm.title: Skills and feats
lines: Bluff +2, Disguise +4, Hide +6, Listen +3, Move Silently +2, Sense Motive +3, Spot +3. Skill Focus (Disguise). Speaks Oneiros and the languages of its current prey.

gm.title: Encounter details
lines: Any land or underground (dreams). Solitary, pair, gang of 3–6, or pack of 9–20. No treasure. Always lawful neutral. Advances at 4–6 HD (Medium) or 7–9 HD (Large). If forced to fight, it resumes its natural form and claws its attacker.

gm.title: Description
lines: A swamp or woodland hag who uses false cries for help to lure travelers into danger. This hag belongs to a three-member coven.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Amphibious. She can breathe air and water.
Mimicry. She can imitate animal sounds and humanoid voices. A listener identifies the imitation with a successful DC 14 Wisdom (Insight) check.

gm.title: Innate spellcasting
lines:
Charisma (spell save DC 12). She needs no material components.
At will: Dancing Lights, Minor Illusion, Vicious Mockery.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage.
Illusory Appearance. The hag disguises herself and everything she wears or carries as a creature of her general size and humanoid shape. She can end the effect with a bonus action, and it ends if she dies. Touch can reveal discrepancies between the illusion and her body. A creature can also spend an action inspecting the disguise and identify it with a successful DC 20 Intelligence (Investigation) check.
Invisible Passage. She becomes Invisible, as does everything she wears or carries. The effect ends when she attacks, casts a spell, or loses Concentration as if concentrating on a spell. During the effect she leaves no physical evidence of her passage. Only magic can track her.

gm.title: Printed source
lines: Monster Manual (2014), pp. 176–177. The coven sidebar is on p. 176.

gm.title: Variant rules
lines: Green Hag (Coven) is the other library label for the same printed coven profile.

gm.title: Shared spellcasting
lines:
A coven has three hags of any type. All three can use these wizard spells while they are within 30 ft. of one another. Track one pool of spell slots for the whole coven. Each hag casts as a 12th-level spellcaster using Intelligence. This hag uses spell save DC 13 and +5 to hit with spell attacks for this list.
1st level (4 slots): Identify, Ray of Sickness.
2nd level (3 slots): Hold Person, Locate Object.
3rd level (3 slots): Bestow Curse, Counterspell, Lightning Bolt.
4th level (3 slots): Phantasmal Killer, Polymorph.
5th level (2 slots): Contact Other Plane, Scrying.
6th level (1 slot): Eyebite.

gm.title: Hag Eye
lines: A coven can have one Hag Eye. A coven member on the same plane can spend an action to see through it. The eye has AC 10, 1 HP, and darkvision 60 ft. If it is destroyed, each coven member takes 3d10 psychic damage and becomes Blinded for 24 hours. All three hags must perform a 1-hour ritual to make a new eye. They cannot do so while Blinded, and an action outside the ritual makes them start over.

gm.title: Hag Coven
lines: When all three coven members are within 30 ft. of one another, each casts with Intelligence as a 12th-level caster. The coven shares the spell slots. Each hag has save DC 12 plus her Intelligence modifier and spell attack bonus 4 plus that modifier.

Slots and spells by tier: 1st (4) identify, ray of sickness. 2nd (3) hold person, locate object. 3rd (3) bestow curse, counterspell, lightning bolt. 4th (3) phantasmal killer, polymorph. 5th (2) contact other plane, scrying. 6th (1) eyebite.

The three can create one hag eye in an uninterrupted hour. A hag can spend an action to see through it from the same plane. It has AC 10, 1 HP and Darkvision 60 ft. Destroying it deals 3d10 psychic damage to each member and Blinds them for 24 hours.

lines: Green slaadi can arise when a red or blue slaad curses a host capable of casting spells of level 3 or higher. Green slaadi often direct their kin toward portals that gray slaadi scout.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Magic Resistance. The creature makes saving throws with Advantage against spells and other magical effects.
Regeneration. The slaad regains 10 HP at the start of each of its turns while it has at least 1 HP.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make three Chaos Staff attacks.
Chaos Staff. Melee or ranged attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 60 ft. A hit deals 8 (1d8 + 4) Force damage. Roll a d4 to determine the condition affecting the target until the start of the slaad's next turn. On 1 it is Charmed, on 2 Frightened, on 3 Poisoned, and on 4 Incapacitated.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:
As an action, cast one of the listed spells using Charisma (save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks) without Material components.
At will. Detect Magic, Detect Thoughts, Mage Hand.
1/day each. Fireball, Invisibility (self only).

gm.title: Bonus actions
lines: Shape-Shift. Become a Small or Medium Humanoid or return to the slaad's true form. Its size is the only statistic that can change. Worn and carried equipment keeps its usual form.

gm.title: Slaad control gems
lines:
A slaad born from the Spawning Stone carries a magical control gem in its head. Once another creature claims the gem, the slaad is Charmed and obeys the bearer. It stops being Charmed if the bearer or the bearer's allies harm it, if someone returns the gem to the slaad, or if Greater Restoration destroys the gem when cast on the slaad.
Wish can retrieve the gem. If the slaad fails its save against Imprisonment, the caster gets the gem and the slaad stays free. Removing the gem from an Incapacitated slaad takes 1 minute and a successful DC 20 Wisdom (Medicine) check. Failure deals 22 (4d10) Piercing damage to the slaad.

lines: Monster Manual (2024), p. 286. The Slaad Control Gems sidebar supplies the control gem rules.

lines: These nimble pests spring traps and leap onto intruders in packs.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Initiative +10. AC 18 (+2 size, +6 Dex), touch 18, flat-footed 12. Base attack +1, grapple −10. Space 2½ ft., reach 0 ft. Fort +2, Ref +8, Will −1. Hide +18, Listen +4, Move Silently +8, Sleight of Hand +12, Spot +4, Tumble +10. Dodge, Improved Initiative, Weapon Finesse (bonus). Darkvision 60 ft. and low-light vision. Any land, often in darkness. Swarm of 20–40. Double standard treasure. Usually chaotic evil. Advances at 2–3 HD (Small).

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack. Claw +8 melee (1d2−3).
Full attack. Two claws +8 melee (1d2−3 each) and bite +3 melee (1d3−3).
Improved Grab (Ex). If both claws hit, attempt to grab. On success, the gremishka latches on and deals its bite damage automatically each round. Its target is not grappled but carries the gremishka’s 4 lb. Attacks from someone else deal damage to the gremishka first. Excess beyond its HP goes to the creature carrying it.
Swarm (Ex). Up to 20 gremishkas can attack and latch onto a Medium target in one round. Double that limit per size category larger or halve it per category smaller. Every four attached gremishkas add 1 to their combined bite damage.

gm.title: Bright light
lines: Skitterish (Ex). Sudden bright light, such as from daylight, calls for a DC 15 Fear save. Ravenloft Fear save. Roll against the DC using Will and applicable fear adjustments. Failure by 1–5 leaves the target shaken, 6–10 frightened, and 11 or more panicked for 5d6 rounds. Failure by 16 or more also calls for an immediate Horror save at the Fear DC minus 5. Another failed Fear save escalates an existing fear effect by one step. See Ravenloft Player’s Handbook, pp. 77–79.

gm.title: Tactics and languages
lines: Groups prefer dark ambush sites and often build traps. They speak Gremishka, and some understand human languages without speaking them.

lines: A lake-dwelling fey that prowls longhouses after dark. Its mantle of shadow lets it seize prey and move it away unseen.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: AC includes Shadow Armor. Perception 14, Stealth 17. Resists poison damage. Immune to cold damage, Charmed, and Frightened. Darkvision 90 ft. Speaks Sylvan.

gm.title: Ability modifiers
lines: Str +5, Dex +3, Con +6, Int -1, Wis +2, Cha -2

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Amphibious. Breathes air and water.
Fey Resilience. The printed trait grants resistance to Charmed and Unconscious. The stat line grants immunity to Charmed.
Shadow Armor. The mantle gives +3 AC, included in the listed AC, and raises Stealth to 22 in dim light or darkness.
Sunlight Sensitivity. In sunlight it rolls checks and attacks with disadvantage, loses Shadow Armor, and cannot use Shadow Snare. Existing snares melt.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and one Claws attack. It can replace Claws with Shadow Snare.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 17 (4d6 + 3) piercing damage. A critical hit makes the target Frightened until the end of the grendelkyn’s next turn.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 14 (2d10 + 3) slashing damage.
Shadow Snare. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 9 (2d8) cold damage. The target makes a DC 14 Dexterity save or becomes Blinded and Restrained for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns to escape. The snare also ends if sunlight reaches the target, the grendelkyn dies or becomes Incapacitated, or it chooses to snare another target.

gm.title: Bonus Actions
lines: Shadow Port. Teleport up to 30 ft. to a visible, unoccupied space in dim light or darkness, starting in dim light or darkness. A creature held in Shadow Snare also teleports 30 ft. to an unoccupied space in dim light or darkness within 10 ft. of the grendelkyn. If no such space exists, the grendelkyn releases it when teleporting.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Frenzied Shriek. When reduced to 43 HP or fewer, the grendelkyn can shriek. Each creature within 20 ft. makes a DC 12 Wisdom save or becomes Frightened for 1 minute, with a repeat save at the end of each of its turns to end the condition.

gm.title: Heraldic servant rules
lines:
Printed source. Heraldic Servant, General, pp. 44–46.
A heraldic servant has an inactive form on its coat of arms and two active forms, one natural and one humanoid. The rightful bearer can summon one servant at any time. It must touch the coat of arms to return to it or transfer to another coat of arms.
Use the same hit points in either active form. Unless the entry gives an exception, use the same Armor Class and magical powers as well. Weapons and movement may depend on form. An active servant automatically defends its bearer unless ordered otherwise. It can only be killed while active.
An active servant and its bearer can share thoughts and senses telepathically within one mile. While linked, the bearer counts as one experience level higher and shares the servant's spell immunities and magic resistance. While the servant is inactive, personally carrying its coat of arms grants the extra level and magic resistance. Check the individual entry for additional benefits.
The servant's death removes all benefits and permanently costs its bearer two levels. The servant can return at the bearer's deathbed if a new generation takes over. Three consecutive unworthy generations lose its service until two consecutive generations prove worthy.
A heraldic servant needs neither food nor sleep and earns no XP. It remains neutral or takes its bearer's alignment. The Red Curse cannot give it Legacies or Affliction.

Extra Turning, Improved Initiative, Multiattack. Solitary on any land. No treasure. Always neutral good. Advances at 5–8 HD (Medium) or 9–15 HD (Large).

gm.title: Actions

Dog attack or full attack. Bite +7 melee (2d6+3).
Owl attack. Claws +6 melee (1d4+2). Full attack adds bite +4 melee (1d6+2).
Frightful Presence (Ex). It howls or screeches when it first detects evil on its grounds and can repeat the howl at will as a standard action. Evil creatures within 30 ft. make a DC 15 Fear save. A success grants immunity to this grim’s Frightful Presence for one day.
Turning (Su). Turn or destroy evil undead and outsiders as a 9th-level cleric.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
The grim chooses dog or owl form at dusk and retains it until dawn. Most statistics are shared across both forms. It fades in daylight, invisible and intangible, and returns fully healed at sunset. It never leaves its grounds and does not need food or sleep.
Detect Corruption (Su). It continually detects evil undead and outsiders within 60 ft. It has a 20% chance per failed powers check to detect corruption in other creatures.
DR 15/magic and spell resistance 16. Immune to necromantic effects. Magic circle against evil operates continuously at caster level 12th and cannot be suppressed. Sense Motive and Spot get a +4 racial bonus.

gm.title: Fear save
lines: Ravenloft Fear save. Roll against the DC using Will and applicable fear adjustments. Failure by 1–5 leaves the target shaken, 6–10 frightened, and 11 or more panicked for 5d6 rounds. Failure by 16 or more also calls for an immediate Horror save at the Fear DC minus 5. Another failed Fear save escalates an existing fear effect by one step. gm.title: Description
lines: A robed spirit comes to collect a dying creature’s soul. It fights only if someone interferes.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Initiative +2. AC components +2 Dex and +8 deflection. Base attack +5, grapple +7 as printed. Space 5 ft., reach 5 ft. Fort +4, Ref +6, Will +6.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack or full attack. +2 scythe at +9 melee. Use the blade for 2d4 + 5 nonlethal damage and Destruction, or the pole for 1d6 + 5 nonlethal damage and Feign Death.
Destruction (Su). A living creature hit by the blade makes a DC 16 Fortitude save or dies. Only true resurrection or miracle restores a victim slain this way.
Feign Death (Su). The pole forces a DC 16 Will save. Failure leaves the target in a deathlike trance for 5 minutes. Magic can discern life.
Gaze of Fear (Su). As a standard action, target a foe with a DC 16 Fear save. Looking at the reaper by itself does not trigger the effect.

gm.title: Traits
lines: DR 5/bludgeoning. Immune to cold, mind-affecting effects, and necromantic effects. Electricity and fire resistance 10. Incorporeal and Mists subtype traits. Only the dying and creatures that see ethereal or invisible beings can see it. Attacking does not end invisibility. Speak with dead can allow communication.

gm.title: Running the encounter
lines: When a character in Ravenloft is dying, use a 5% appearance chance and add 5 percentage points for each prior brush with death. Reaching −8 HP or dying and returning counts. It alternates scythe and gaze from round to round when opposed. Death ward protects its intended target. Any healing magic used on that target makes the reaper leave. If the reaper is slain, the target stabilizes and regains 10% of maximum HP.

gm.title: Skills and feats

gm.title: Encounter details

gm.title: Table notes

lines: A small green-scaled, dragonlike quadruped with a spined back, a broad jaw and a long tail.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Level 2 Brute. Initiative +3. Fortitude 15, Reflex 13, Will 12. Bloodied 24. Perception +7. No languages.

gm.title: Printed source
lines: Wizards of the Coast, Keep on the Shadowfell (2009 revision), pp. 20, 32. Encounter A4, Burial Site, and Area 3, Excavation Site.

gm.title: Printed ability modifiers
lines: Str +4, Dex +3, Con +5, Int -3, Wis +2, Cha +2.

gm.title: Printed powers
lines: Bite. Melee basic, standard, at-will. +6 vs. AC. Hit for 1d10 + 3 damage, or 1d10 + 9 while the drake is within 2 squares of an ally.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Immune to fear while within 2 squares of an ally.

gm.title: Encounter A4 checks
lines: Agrid orders the two drakes to charge the most formidable-looking PC. An Insight check opposed by Agrid’s Bluff can expose his deception, which prompts the order to attack. Climbing the steep slope requires DC 15 Athletics and goes at half speed.

gm.title: Area 3 checks
lines:
DC 15 Perception finds the secret door that leads to Area 4. DC 10 Perception hears goblin voices, and a Goblin speaker can make DC 15 Perception to understand the argument. The two drakes help keep adventurers down in the excavation. A drop from a plank or ledge is 10 ft., deals 1d10 damage and leaves the creature prone. The earth wall requires DC 15 Athletics. On each attempt it crumbles on 1–10 on a d20, sliding the climber to the floor and leaving them prone in their starting square without damage.
A Medium creature crossing a plank needs DC 15 Acrobatics. Heavy armor breaks the plank. A PC or goblin can push an unoccupied plank as a minor action. An occupied plank requires a DC 14 Strength check for a Small occupant or DC 17 for a Medium occupant. Rocking a plank takes a standard action and a Strength check against the occupant’s Reflex. Success drops the occupant into the excavation. Ladders take 4 squares of movement to climb 10 ft. A PC or goblin can topple one as a standard action and use a standard action with DC 10 Strength to reposition it. Guard drakes use the ramp and cannot manipulate planks or ladders.

lines: A tentacled sea predator that can seize several creatures at once and swallow them alive. Its stomach can hold relics from earlier prey.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Natural armor. Perception 12, Stealth 14 (19 underwater). Resistant to Exhaustion and Frightened. Darkvision 60 ft. No languages.

gm.title: Ability modifiers
lines: Str +6, Dex +0, Con +9, Int +0, Wis +2, Cha +1

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Amphibious. Breathes air and water.
Monstrosity Resilience. Resistant to Exhaustion and Frightened.
Seagoing Lurker. Stealth is 19 underwater.
Siege Monster. Double damage to objects and structures.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make four Tentacle attacks. One can be replaced with Bite.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 28 (4d10 + 6) piercing damage. The attack has advantage against a creature Grappled by one of its tentacles.
Tentacle. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Hit 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage. A Huge or smaller creature is Grappled (escape DC 18), and the hafgufa can pull it up to 25 ft. straight toward itself. It can hold four creatures at once.
Reeking Mist (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 40-ft. cube centered on the hafgufa makes a DC 17 Constitution save or becomes Incapacitated for 10 minutes. Repeat the save at the end of each turn to end the effect.

gm.title: Bonus Actions
lines: Swallow. A Large or smaller creature that the hafgufa is Grappling within 5 ft. makes a DC 18 Strength save. On a failure it is swallowed and the Grapple ends. A swallowed creature is Blinded and Restrained, has total cover against outside attacks and effects, and takes 28 (8d6) acid damage at the start of each of the hafgufa’s turns. Capacity six. If a creature inside deals at least 40 damage in a single turn, the hafgufa makes a DC 19 Constitution save at the end of that turn. On a failure it expels everyone inside, each falling Prone within 10 ft. When the hafgufa dies, the restraint ends and a swallowed creature can spend 20 ft. of movement to exit Prone.

gm.title: Encounter Context
lines: Optional stomach find (1d6): 1, a very rare magic item from a past hero. 2, a lost ruler’s crown worth 2,000 gp. 3, an old message in a sealed bottle. 4, a treasure map etched on lead. 5, a rune-marked iron key for a giant’s lock. 6, a pirate captain’s cursed bones in a strongbox.

gm.title: Actions
lines:

gm.title: Bonus Actions
lines: Soul Stitch. Choose one visible creature within 15 ft. On a failed DC 16 Wisdom save, its soul is bound to the hag for 1 minute. It has disadvantage on saves against the hag’s spells and other features and cannot teleport, enter portals, or otherwise travel magically. It can repeat the save at the end of each turn, ending the bond on a success.

gm.title: Half-dragon template
lines:
Start with a beast, humanoid, giant, or monstrosity. Keep its statistics except for the template changes. Give it blindsight 10 ft., darkvision 60 ft., and Draconic in addition to its languages.
Color determines resistance. Black and copper resist acid. Blue and bronze resist lightning. Brass, gold, and red resist fire. Green resists poison. Silver and white resist cold.
Give the creature its dragon color's breath weapon. Use a wyrmling's breath for Large or smaller, a young dragon's for Huge, and an adult dragon's for Gargantuan. The minimum starting CRs to use this template without recalculating CR are 2, 7, and 8 for those size categories, respectively. If the base creature falls below that threshold, recalculate its CR using the Dungeon Master's Guide.

gm.title: Description
lines: This swift ambusher cannot outrun its grave’s pull. A storm can destroy it even when weapons cannot.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Fledgling sample, 5th-level halfling rogue. Initiative +21. Touch AC 18, flat-footed AC 19. BAB +5, grapple +5. Space and reach 5 ft. Fort +3, Ref +15, Will +5.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack or full attack. Choose slam +4 melee (1d4 and 1d4 Strength damage plus 1d4 Dexterity damage to a living target), or +1 dagger +13 melee or ranged (1d4, 19–20/×2). Sneak attack adds 3d6 when applicable.
Fatigue Aura (Su). A living creature coming within 60 ft. makes a DC 14 Will save. Failure fatigues it for 1d6 rounds, or exhausts it for that duration if already fatigued.
Blood Drain (Ex). Pin a living target in a grapple. Each round the pin holds, drain 1d4 Constitution and gain 5 temporary HP.
Spell-like abilities. At will purify food and water, 3/day create food and water, caster level 12. At will as a standard action it can despoil 12 cubic ft. of food and water. The Despoil text gives save DC 10 + Charisma modifier (12 here), while the sample gives DC 12 + spell level for spell-like abilities.
Children of the Night (Su, 1/day). Standard action to call 4d8 dogs or 4d10 cats. They arrive in 2d6 rounds and serve up to 1 hour.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Cold and electricity resistance 20, turn resistance +4, undead traits, evasion and uncanny dodge. Padfoot makes its movement silent. Gaseous form smells like pipe tobacco, gives fly 20 ft. (perfect), and can be maintained indefinitely. Alternate Form can assume a boar, dog, riding dog, or owl. As a standard action assume the listed animal form. Lose the slam and domination, gain the animal’s natural weapons and extraordinary attacks, and retain this form until the next sunrise or another change. Fast healing is 3 when the moon is less than half full, 4 at half or gibbous, and 5 on the three nights of the full moon. At 0 HP it takes gaseous form and retreats to its coffin. It is destroyed if it cannot reach the coffin within 2 hours. At the coffin it remains helpless for 1 hour, reaches 1 HP, and then resumes fast healing.

gm.title: Spawn
lines: A halfling slain by Constitution drain becomes spawn at 4 HD or fewer and a halfling vampire at 5 HD or more. Both remain controlled until their creator dies. Halfling spawn are Small with +1 size to attack and AC and retain DC 14 Fatigue Aura. Their slam deals just 1d4 Strength damage as its special rider. Blood Drain, gaseous form and fast healing use ordinary spawn rules.

gm.title: Repelling and slaying
lines: Heavy tobacco smoke other than its own gaseous form repels it. So does a clearly presented holy symbol. A hearth fire bars it from the room and an upright horseshoe over a doorway or window bars passage. It can rest only within 1 mile of its original grave. Sunlight leaves one chance to escape before destruction next round. Running water costs one-third of HP each round and destroys it after 3 rounds of immersion. Rain deals 1d6 acid per round, a thunderstorm 1d8 and a hurricane 1d10. At 0 HP or less from rain it is destroyed. Only a still-burning wooden stake fresh from a hearth kills it while left in place. The book gives permanent destruction if its severed hands and feet burn in a hearth for three hours.

gm.title: Skills and feats
lines: Balance +15, Bluff +18, Climb +10, Disable Device +11, Disguise +10, Forgery +11, Hide +23, Jump +10, Listen +14, Move Silently +17, Open Lock +15, Search +11, Sense Motive +10, Spot +12, Tumble +15. Alertness, Combat Reflexes, Dodge, Improved Initiative, Lightning Reflexes, Shield Proficiency, Weapon Finesse.

gm.title: Encounter adaptation
lines: Apply the strain to the 3.5 vampire template. Retain unmodified abilities, size, BAB, saves and skill points. The base vampire uses undead d12 Hit Dice and has no Constitution score. Keep an existing swim speed and ignore vulnerability to immersion in running water if the base creature can swim. Use save DC 10 + half HD rounded down + Charisma modifier unless specified. Age rows replace one another. Apply only to a halfling. Fast healing numbers correspond to less than half, half or gibbous, and the three nights of the full moon.

gm.title: Age modifiers
lines:
Apply one row to a base creature. The sample already includes its adjustments. Ability scores are listed in Str, Dex, Int, Wis, Cha order.
Fledgling. Abilities 0/6/2/4/6. Speed +0 ft., natural AC +6, turn resistance +4, CR +1. Fast healing 3/4/5.
Mature. Abilities 0/6/2/6/8. Speed +10 ft., natural AC +6, turn resistance +4, CR +1. Fast healing 3/4/5.
Old. Abilities 2/8/4/6/8. Speed +10 ft., natural AC +7, turn resistance +5, CR +2. Fast healing 4/5/6.
Ancient. Abilities 2/8/4/8/10. Speed +20 ft., natural AC +7, turn resistance +6, CR +2. Fast healing 4/5/6.
Eminent. Abilities 4/10/6/8/10. Speed +20 ft., natural AC +8, turn resistance +7, CR +3. Fast healing 5/6/8.
Patriarch. Abilities 6/12/8/10/12. Speed +30 ft., natural AC +8, turn resistance +8, CR +4. Fast healing 6/8/10.

lines: Initiative +21 and BAB/grapple +5/+5 are printed and kept. The sample does not list the base vampire’s damage reduction.

gm.title: Description
lines: A spiderlike head can puppet a corpse or call for help from behind a web of nearly invisible blades.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Initiative +2. AC 14 (+2 size, +2 Dex). Base attack +1, grapple −7. Space and reach 2½ ft. Fort +0, Ref +2, Will +3. Bluff +5, Disguise +6, Hide +11, Listen +7, Move Silently +9, Spot +2. Weapon Finesse. Any land or underground. Solitary. No treasure. Always neutral evil.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack or full attack. Bite +4 melee (1d6−2 plus poison), or slam +0 melee (1d3) in a host body.
Poison (Ex). The bite carries poison. Up to 3/day the head hunter can also spit contact venom at a target within 15 ft. with a ranged touch attack. Fortitude DC 13, initial and secondary damage 2d4 Constitution.
Razor Web (Ex). Spinning takes full-round actions, at a rate of one 5-ft. cube per minute and at most two cubes per day. Spot DC 20 notices a web. Each web square a creature crosses attacks at +10 melee for 2d6 damage. On a critical hit, roll 1d10. On 1–9 a random limb is severed, adding nonlethal damage equal to the normal damage and bleeding as from a wounding weapon. On 10 it cuts off the target’s head as a vorpal weapon would. Each web square has AC 8 and 10 HP.

gm.title: Host body (Ex)
lines: It can spend one minute implanting itself in a corpse killed in its web and feed on it for ten days. It can puppet a Small to Large corpse. The printed Medium host has 1d10 HD (5 HP), AC 12, Str 10, Dex 10, Ref +0, Hide +2, Move Silently +4, and 5-ft. space and reach. Hits damage the host unless an attacker specifically targets the head. When the host is destroyed, the head hunter falls as if dead. Left unattended it crawls out and seeks another corpse. Entering a new host restores its own HP.

gm.title: Traits and tactics
lines: Immune to poison and webbing. It climbs any webs freely, including its own razor web. It and its web take double fire damage, and fire damage spreads to every square in the web. Tremorsense 60 ft. detects anything touching the ground or its webs. It is effectively blinded to targets beyond 20 ft. that evade tremorsense. Seeing it without a host or on a quadruped calls for a DC 13 Ravenloft Horror save (Will). Speaks Elven, Drow, and several domain languages. Racial +5 on Bluff, Disguise, Hide, Listen, and Move Silently.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: The printed host AC is 12 with a listed +2 Dex component, though the host’s bracketed Dexterity is 10. Use the listed total. The text gives the web’s critical result as 1–10 without naming the die, so use 1d10. The spit has no printed attack bonus. Use +5 ranged touch for the unhosted form from its listed base attack, Dexterity, and size.

lines: A hearth fiend lives inside a stubborn flame. It whispers bargains from the fire and tries to get a servant to build it a bigger one.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Any land or underground, inside an open fire. Solitary. Always chaotic evil. No treasure. Advancement 3–5 HD (Medium), 6–9 HD (Large), or 10–18 HD (Huge). No level adjustment listed. Speaks Ignan and can communicate with any creature that has a language.

gm.title: Combat statistics
lines: Initiative +5 as printed. AC 15 (+1 size, +1 Dex as printed, +3 natural). Touch AC 12 and flat-footed AC 14 use those listed bonuses. Base attack +1, grapple −3. Space and reach 5 ft. Fort +0, Ref +4, Will +0.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Damage reduction 10/magic, elemental traits, Fire and Mists subtypes, and immunity to electricity. Normally invisible, visible at will, and detectable with see invisibility. The fire it occupies stays lit until it is slain or driven out. Water Vulnerability (Ex). Magically created water deals 1d4 damage per gallon.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack or full attack. Fire bolt +3 ranged (1d6 damage, ignites flammables) or slam (1d4 plus 1d4 fire). Use +2 melee for the slam as a table default.
Burn (Su). A fire bolt reaches 10 ft. per HD (20 ft. for this fiend). A creature hit must make a DC 14 Reflex save or catch fire for 1d4 rounds. Use the 3.5 catching-on-fire procedure.
Transfer Flame. As a standard action, transfer to another open flame within 5 ft.
Fire Charm (Su). Someone near the flame must succeed on a DC 15 Listen check to make out its whispers, then make a DC 14 Will save or be affected as by charm person (caster level 8th). The fiend can charm only one creature at a time. It may keep trying until the target gives in or leaves.

lines: Casting a fire-based spell in Ravenloft has a 1% chance per spell level to draw a hearth fiend into the nearest open flame.

gm.title: Table notes

gm.title: Actions
lines:

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Use servants to hold foes back while casting or using the gaze from behind a lesser globe of invulnerability. Use greater teleport to flee if gravely threatened.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: The summary lists gaze immunity broadly. The detailed rule limits it to reptilian sources. The preferred spell list contains dominate monster but the creature casts as a 14th-level wizard. Use the native wizard slot limits and leave that 9th-level spell unprepared in this encounter. The spell list is a set of preferences rather than a prepared loadout.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Hellish Bite (group attack). Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 3 fire damage per participant. If at least two curs joined and the target is other than a hellhound, it makes a Dexterity save against DC 10 + the number of participants. On failure it burns for 1 minute, taking fire damage equal to that participant count at the start of each turn while burning. A successful repeat save at the end of a turn ends the fire early. The target or a creature within reach of it can also spend an action to put out the fire. If it catches fire again on a later turn, reset the duration to 1 minute without stacking the damage.

gm.title: MCDM minion rules
lines:
Minions of the same stat block normally share a turn and can all move before taking their actions. They use fixed damage, cannot score critical hits, and have no Hit Dice to spend.
A minion drops to 0 HP if an attack damages it or it takes damage from failing a save. Other damage kills it if the damage meets or exceeds its maximum HP. Otherwise the minion ignores that damage.
Overkill. When a weapon hit deals more damage than a minion’s maximum HP, apply the excess to an additional minion of the same stat block, as weapon attack damage. Repeat while damage remains after subtracting each target’s maximum HP. Melee targets must be within reach of the attack. Ranged targets must lie along the line of the attack and within the weapon’s normal range. Opportunity attacks cannot overkill.
Group attack. Two to five minions of the same stat block sharing a turn can each spend their action to make one attack if the target is within reach or range of each participant. Roll once, adding +1 for each participant, and multiply the fixed damage by that same count on a hit. Use advantage or disadvantage only if it applies to everyone in the group. Split groups when the target has different cover or concealment from different attackers.
A minion can make a group attack alone using its listed attack bonus and damage. If multiple eligible minions could make the same melee opportunity attack, they can each use their reaction to join one group attack. If the group attack triggers an effect against a single attacker, its target chooses which participating minion it affects.

gm.title: Description
lines: A dead hero takes a living host to finish a deed or disgrace the villain who stopped it.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Very rare, solitary. Retains its alignment from life. Fearless morale 20. No magic resistance, treasure, Legacies or cinnabryl requirement.

gm.title: Actions
lines: The spirit has no direct attack. When the host faces deadly peril, it awakens and automatically influences the host with suggestion to rush into battle. Use the effects of a potion of super-heroism regardless of the host’s class. The host must fight with conspicuous daring for one round per foe, with a minimum of 4 and a maximum of 15 rounds. Afterward the host chooses whether to keep fighting or withdraw with flair.

gm.title: Running the encounter
lines: Outside combat the spirit mostly lies dormant and communicates through empathy alone. Its host keeps free will under ordinary conditions. A host who adopts the spirit’s flamboyant habits may gain Luck and reroll a failed saving throw or ability check. That benefit can persist while the spirit is dormant. It leaves after fulfilling its goal or moves on if the host gains a level first or dies.

gm.title: Exorcism and rivalry
lines: The spirit cannot be attacked or turned directly, but exorcism can drive it out. A good spirit leaves if a host sincerely asks. It never chooses a host already carrying a Legacy Leech. Both spirits recognize one another when their hosts meet. If the spirit’s host refuses to attack the leech’s host, it attempts to seize control with magic jar, potentially forcing a fight to the death.

gm.title: Experience
lines: Award the host 450 XP once, upon the spirit’s first activation. Helping it finish its deed earns a further 1,000 XP.

gm.title: Printed source
lines: pp. 100–101, with Luck Legacy on p. 8

gm.title: Super-heroism
lines: Use the host’s current level. Level 0: +6 effective combat levels and 5d10 bonus HP. Levels 1–3: +5 and 4d10 + 1. Levels 4–6: +4 and 3d10 + 2. Levels 7–9: +3 and 2d10 + 3. Levels 10–12: +2 and 1d10 + 4. A host of level 13 or higher gains no bonus. Deduct damage from the bonus HP first. The spirit’s encounter rules determine duration and allow any class. See Encyclopedia Magica, Volume III, p. 890.

gm.title: MCDM minion rules
lines:
Minions of the same stat block normally share a turn and can all move before taking their actions. They use fixed damage, cannot score critical hits, and have no Hit Dice to spend.
A minion drops to 0 HP if an attack damages it or it takes damage from failing a save. Other damage kills it if the damage meets or exceeds its maximum HP. Otherwise the minion ignores that damage.
Overkill. When a weapon hit deals more damage than a minion’s maximum HP, apply the excess to an additional minion of the same stat block, as weapon attack damage. Repeat while damage remains after subtracting each target’s maximum HP. Melee targets must be within reach of the attack. Ranged targets must lie along the line of the attack and within the weapon’s normal range. Opportunity attacks cannot overkill.
Group attack. Two to five minions of the same stat block sharing a turn can each spend their action to make one attack if the target is within reach or range of each participant. Roll once, adding +1 for each participant, and multiply the fixed damage by that same count on a hit. Use advantage or disadvantage only if it applies to everyone in the group. Split groups when the target has different cover or concealment from different attackers.
A minion can make a group attack alone using its listed attack bonus and damage. If multiple eligible minions could make the same melee opportunity attack, they can each use their reaction to join one group attack. If the group attack triggers an effect against a single attacker, its target chooses which participating minion it affects.

gm.title: Description
lines: This giant shapechanger poses as a pile of treasure. Some dragons use one as a decoy. A cornered hoard mimic may trade the real hoard's location for its life.

gm.title: Traits
lines: False Appearance (hoard form only). If motionless when combat starts, the mimic has advantage on initiative. A creature that has never seen it move or act must pass a DC 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to recognize that it is animate.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and two Pseudopod attacks.

gm.title: Appearance
lines: A red-skinned hobgoblin in layered hide and bronze, carrying a brazier-topped standard and a worn round shield.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Hide armor. Immune to fire damage. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 10. Common, Goblin, Infernal.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Infernal Ichor. A creature within 5 ft. that reduces the brandbearer to 0 HP takes 1 fire damage.
Too Hot to Handle. When an enemy takes fire damage from a non-minion creature, it takes an extra 1 fire damage for each brandbearer within 5 ft. of it.
Minion. Damage from an attack or failed save drops the brandbearer to 0 HP. Any other effect kills it if it deals at least 12 damage. The brandbearer ignores smaller amounts from those effects.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Searing Grasp (Group Attack). Melee spell attack +5, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 4 fire damage. On a hit by at least three brandbearers, the target also has disadvantage on saves against fire-damaging spells, powers, and other supernatural effects until the start of the brandbearers’ next turn.

gm.title: Minion rules
lines:
Group attack. Two to five brandbearers on the same turn can each spend an action to use Searing Grasp on a target within reach of all of them. Roll once at +5 plus the number of participants. A hit deals 4 fire damage per participant. A lone brandbearer uses +5. Advantage or disadvantage applies if all participants have it. Use separate rolls for groups with different cover or concealment. The target picks which brandbearer receives any response that can affect only one attacker.
Group opportunity attack. If an enemy provokes at the same time from multiple brandbearers, each can spend its reaction to join a Searing Grasp attack. Brandbearers have no Hit Dice and cannot score critical hits.
Overkill. Weapon damage above the first brandbearer’s 12 HP maximum drops one eligible additional brandbearer to 0 HP per 12 surplus damage or part thereof. For melee, eligible brandbearers are within the weapon’s reach. At range, they lie on the line from the attacker through the first target, within the weapon’s short range. Overkill excludes opportunity attacks.

gm.title: Encounter uses
lines: Use behind a shield line beside a War Mage or another non-minion ally with fire attacks. A group can set up a tougher fire save, then the caster can follow while the brandbearers keep close to the enemy.

gm.title: Heraldic servant rules
lines:
Printed source. Heraldic Servant, General, pp. 44–46.
A heraldic servant has an inactive form on its coat of arms and two active forms, one natural and one humanoid. The rightful bearer can summon one servant at any time. It must touch the coat of arms to return to it or transfer to another coat of arms.
Use the same hit points in either active form. Unless the entry gives an exception, use the same Armor Class and magical powers as well. Weapons and movement may depend on form. An active servant automatically defends its bearer unless ordered otherwise. It can only be killed while active.
An active servant and its bearer can share thoughts and senses telepathically within one mile. While linked, the bearer counts as one experience level higher and shares the servant's spell immunities and magic resistance. While the servant is inactive, personally carrying its coat of arms grants the extra level and magic resistance. Check the individual entry for additional benefits.
The servant's death removes all benefits and permanently costs its bearer two levels. The servant can return at the bearer's deathbed if a new generation takes over. Three consecutive unworthy generations lose its service until two consecutive generations prove worthy.
A heraldic servant needs neither food nor sleep and earns no XP. It remains neutral or takes its bearer's alignment. The Red Curse cannot give it Legacies or Affliction.

gm.title: Appearance
lines: A young mage with windswept hair, maroon studded leather, a blue cloak and an open spellbook.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Studded leather. Arcana +5. Passive Perception 10. Common plus any two languages.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Empower Patron. The mage chooses a non-minion patron. At the start of the patron’s turn, count the apprentice mages who chose that patron, are within 60 ft. of them, and can see them. The patron gains 2 temporary HP for each of those mages.
Exploit Weakness. An attack made with advantage deals 1 extra damage per apprentice making or joining it.
Minion. Damage from an attack or failed save drops the mage to 0 HP. Any other effect kills it if it deals at least 13 damage. The mage ignores smaller amounts from those effects.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Lightning Strike (Group Attack). Ranged spell attack +5, range 120 ft., one creature. Hit 2 lightning damage. If more than one mage made the attack, each participant picks a creature within 30 ft. of the original target. Each selected creature takes 2 lightning damage for each mage that picked it. Exploit Weakness adds no extra damage to these secondary effects.
Thunder Crack (Group Attack). Melee spell attack +5, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 4 thunder damage. The target loses opportunity attacks until the start of its next turn.

gm.title: Minion rules
lines:
Group attack. Two to five apprentice mages on the same turn can each spend an action to use the same attack on one target they can all reach or target at range. Make a single roll at +5 plus the number of mages. A hit deals the listed damage per participant. A solo mage uses +5. Advantage or disadvantage requires every mage to have it. Make separate rolls for groups with different cover or concealment. The target picks which mage receives any response that can affect only one attacker.
Group opportunity attack. When the same creature provokes from multiple apprentices, each can spend its reaction to join Thunder Crack. Apprentices have no Hit Dice and cannot score critical hits.
Overkill. Weapon damage above the first apprentice’s 13 HP maximum drops one eligible additional apprentice to 0 HP per 13 surplus damage or part thereof. For melee, eligible apprentices are within the weapon’s reach. At range, they lie on the line through the first target and within the weapon’s short range. Overkill excludes opportunity attacks.

gm.title: Elemental variants
lines: For an acid, cold, or fire apprentice, change both Lightning Strike and Thunder Crack to that damage type. Participants in the same group attack must deal matching damage types.

gm.title: Encounter uses
lines: Use as apprentices defending a patron or as guards at an arcane college. Breaking their line of sight weakens the patron’s protection.

lines: A funerary attendant in a russet hood and worn leather, carrying a candle and bone pendant.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Death Chant. When an enemy succeeds on a death saving throw within 30 ft. of at least three acolytes who are not Incapacitated, count the success as a failure. On a natural 20, the enemy regains no hit points.
Exploit Weakness. An attack made with advantage deals 1 extra damage per acolyte making or joining the attack.
