gm.title: Actions
lines:
Transfer Life (Group Attack). Melee spell attack +4, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit 2 necrotic damage. If more than one acolyte made the attack, a creature they choose within 30 ft. of them recovers 1 HP per participating acolyte.
Necrotic Bolt (Group Attack). Ranged spell attack +4, range 30 ft., one target. Hit 2 necrotic damage.

gm.title: Minion rules
lines:
Group attack. Two to five acolytes on the same turn can each spend an action to use the same attack against a target all can reach or attack at range. Roll once at +4 plus the number of acolytes. A hit deals 2 necrotic damage per acolyte, or 3 per acolyte with advantage. A lone acolyte uses +4. Advantage or disadvantage applies if all participants have it. Divide participants into separate rolls if the target has different cover or concealment against them. The target chooses which acolyte receives any response that affects only one attacker.
Group opportunity attack. If the same enemy movement provokes an opportunity attack from multiple acolytes, each can spend a reaction to join the melee Transfer Life attack. Acolytes have no Hit Dice and cannot score critical hits.
Overkill. Weapon damage above the initial acolyte’s 9 HP maximum drops one eligible additional acolyte to 0 HP for each 9 points of surplus or part thereof. For melee, each eligible acolyte must be within the weapon’s reach. At range, it must be on the line from attacker through the first target and within the weapon’s short range. Overkill excludes opportunity attacks.

gm.title: Encounter uses

Overwhelm. When a Medium or smaller enemy starts its turn within 5 ft. of three or more guards that can see it, reduce its speed by 5 ft. for each guard within 5 ft. This lasts until the start of the enemy’s next turn. If this reduces its walking speed to 0, it is Restrained for the same duration.

Divide guards with different cover or concealment into separate rolls. The target picks which guard receives any response that can affect only one attacker.

Overwhelm. When a Medium or smaller enemy starts its turn within 5 ft. of three or more guards that can see it, reduce its speed by 5 ft. for each guard within 5 ft. This lasts until the start of the enemy’s next turn. If this reduces its walking speed to 0, it is Restrained for the same duration.
Exploit Weakness. An attack made with advantage deals 1 extra damage per guard making or joining it.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Spear (Group Attack). Melee or ranged weapon attack +3, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit 1 piercing damage.

gm.title: Minion rules
lines:
Group attack. Two to five guards on the same turn can each spend their action to attack one target all of them can reach or target at range. Roll once at +3 plus the number of guards. On a hit, deal 1 piercing damage per guard, or 2 per guard if the roll had advantage. A solo guard uses +3. The group roll has advantage or disadvantage if all participants do. Divide guards with different cover or concealment into separate rolls. The target picks which guard receives any response that can affect only one attacker.
Group opportunity attack. If the same movement provokes from multiple guards, each can spend its reaction to join the melee Spear attack. Guards have no Hit Dice and cannot score critical hits.
Overkill. Weapon damage above the initial guard’s 5 HP maximum drops one eligible additional guard to 0 HP for each 5 points of surplus or part thereof. For melee, eligible guards are within the weapon’s reach. At range, they are on the line from the attacker through the first target and within the weapon’s short range. Overkill does not apply to opportunity attacks.

gm.title: Encounter uses
lines: Use a few guards on a short stretch of wall or at a gate. Their formation can hold a doorway or delay a fleeing suspect.

gm.title: Printed source
lines: Hanging Tree, p. 36. Burnock Mill, p. 64. The White Tower, p. 146.

lines: An amphibious yugoloth that steals memories and recovers things lost beneath the water. Hydroloths sometimes take contracts to sink ships or raid settlements.

gm.title: Damage resistances
lines: Cold, lightning. Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Amphibious. The hydroloth breathes air and water.
Magic Resistance. It has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Secure Memory. The hydroloth is immune to the River Styx’s waters and to effects that read or detect its thoughts or steal or change its memories.
Watery Advantage. It has advantage on attack rolls while submerged in liquid.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two attacks using Bite or Claw. Spellcasting can replace one attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 16 (2d10 + 5) force damage plus 9 (2d10) psychic damage.

Steal Memory (1/day). Choose a creature the hydroloth can see within 60 ft. It takes 14 (4d6) psychic damage and makes a DC 16 Intelligence save. Success grants 24-hour immunity to this hydroloth’s Steal Memory. On a failure the target loses all proficiencies, cannot cast spells or understand language, and has its Intelligence and Charisma scores reduced to 5 if they are higher. The target can repeat the save after each long rest and ends the effect on a success. Greater Restoration or Remove Curse ends it early.
Teleport. The hydroloth teleports up to 60 ft. to an unoccupied space it can see, taking worn and carried gear.

gm.title: Description
lines: Prismeer knows the witch Natasha as Zybilna, the archfey who rules from the Palace of Heart’s Desire.

gm.title: Languages
lines: Abyssal, Celestial, Common, Draconic, Elvish, Infernal, Sylvan.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Boon of Immortality. Magic and other effects cannot age Iggwilv, and old age cannot kill her.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). When Iggwilv fails a save, she can choose to pass it.
Magic Resistance. Her Robe of the Archmagi gives her advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Special Equipment. Iggwilv wears an Amulet of the Planes and a Robe of the Archmagi.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Bewitching Bolt attacks.
Bewitching Bolt. Melee or ranged spell attack, +16 to hit, 5-ft. reach or 120-ft. range, one target. A hit deals 25 (5d6 + 8) lightning damage. If the target is a creature, it must pass a DC 22 Wisdom save or be charmed by Iggwilv until her next turn starts.
Abyssal Rift (recharge 5–6). Open a momentary rift with a 20-ft. radius at a point within 120 ft. Creatures in the sphere make a DC 22 Constitution save, taking 40 (9d8) necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success. Afterward, there is a 50% chance that three Hezrous appear in unoccupied spaces in the sphere. The demons are her allies and act immediately after her. They cannot summon other demons. They remain until they die or she uses an action to dismiss them.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Intelligence without material components. Spell save DC 24, spell attacks +16.
At will. Detect Magic, Disguise Self, Invisibility, Light, Mage Hand, Message, Prestidigitation, Tasha’s Hideous Laughter.
3/day each. Dispel Magic, Fly, Polymorph.
1/day each. Maze, Telekinesis, Teleport, Wish.

gm.title: Bonus actions
lines: Fey Step. Iggwilv teleports to an unoccupied space she can see within 30 ft., taking anything she wears or carries.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Negate Spell (2/day). When Iggwilv sees a creature within 60 ft. casting a spell, she can interrupt it. A spell using a slot of level 8 or lower fails automatically. A 9th-level spell fails if its caster fails a DC 22 Intelligence save.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
Iggwilv has three legendary actions and refreshes them when her turn starts. Spend them on one option at the end of another creature’s turn.
Witchcraft (1 action). Use Spellcasting or Fey Step.
Dark Speech (2 actions). Choose one or two creatures Iggwilv can see within 60 ft. Each makes a DC 22 Wisdom save. On a failure, it takes 11 (2d10) psychic damage and is frightened of her for 1 minute. An affected creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns. A success ends the effect and grants immunity to her Dark Speech for 24 hours.
Fey Beguilement (3 actions). Choose a creature Iggwilv can see within 60 ft. It must pass a DC 22 Charisma save or a fey spirit possesses it and makes it obey her commands. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns. A success banishes the spirit and ends the possession.

gm.title: Palace encounter
lines: The Hourglass Coven used Iggwilv’s Cauldron to freeze her and others in the palace. A frozen creature and its gear cannot be harmed or moved. As an action, touch Iggwilv with a unicorn horn while saying Natasha, her true name, to release her alone. Thaw the whole palace by touching the cauldron with the horn while reciting the Witch Queen’s Cauldron poem, or by shattering the cauldron with a Flame Tongue or Frost Brand weapon. Legend Lore can reveal the poem. Once freed, she can use the horn and poem to thaw the palace.

lines: The Wild Beyond the Witchlight, chapter 5, pp. 173–174, ballroom P22, and pp. 204–206. Stat block on p. 205.

gm.title: Description
lines: The Azorius Senate’s sphinx guildmaster serves as its supreme judge. In a fight, she favors subduing offenders for trial.

gm.title: Damage immunities
lines: Psychic. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Inscrutable. Isperia is immune to effects that sense her emotions or read her thoughts. Divination spells affect her only with her permission. Wisdom (Insight) checks to discern her intentions or sincerity have disadvantage.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). When Isperia fails a saving throw, she can succeed instead.
Magic Resistance. Isperia has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

gm.title: Innate Spellcasting
lines: Wisdom is the spellcasting ability (save DC 23). Isperia can cast Imprisonment twice per day without material components.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:
Isperia casts as a 15th-level Azorius cleric. Wisdom is the spellcasting ability (save DC 23, +14 to hit with spell attacks).
Cantrips (at will). Guidance, Light, Resistance, Sacred Flame, Thaumaturgy.
Level 1 (4 slots). Command, Detect Evil and Good, Ensnaring Strike, Sanctuary, Shield of Faith.
Level 2 (3 slots). Arcane Lock, Augury, Calm Emotions, Hold Person, Silence, Zone of Truth.
Level 3 (3 slots). Bestow Curse, Clairvoyance, Counterspell, Dispel Magic, Tongues.
Level 4 (3 slots). Divination, Locate Creature.
Level 5 (2 slots). Dispel Evil and Good, Scrying.
Level 6 (1 slot). Word of Recall.
Level 7 (1 slot). Divine Word.
Level 8 (1 slot). Antimagic Field.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks. Isperia can replace one with a spell that takes 1 action to cast.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 21 (3d10 + 5) slashing damage. A creature hit must make a DC 23 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it takes 14 (4d6) psychic damage after each attack it makes against Isperia before the start of Isperia’s next turn.
Supreme Legal Authority. Choose up to three creatures Isperia can see within 90 ft. Each makes a DC 23 Intelligence saving throw. For each failure, choose one action the target cannot take for 1 minute: Attack, Cast a Spell, Dash, Disengage, Dodge, Help, Hide, Ready, Search, or Use an Object. The target can repeat the DC 23 Intelligence save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. A creature that succeeds on the save is immune to Isperia’s Supreme Legal Authority for 24 hours.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
The creature has three legendary actions and regains spent actions at the start of its turn. Use one legendary action option at the end of another creature’s turn.
Claw Attack (1 action). Make one Claw attack.
Cast a Spell (2 actions). Cast a prepared spell of 3rd level or lower, spending a spell slot.
Supreme Legal Authority (3 actions). Use Supreme Legal Authority.

gm.title: Printed source
lines: Guildmasters’ Guide to Ravnica, p. 227. Isperia’s role and tactics appear on p. 226.

gm.title: Description
lines: A small ivory elephant guards an entrance. It can grow to full size or drive intruders away with a blast of sound.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Initiative +3. Touch AC 17, flat-footed AC 17. Base attack +1, grapple −11. Space 1 ft., reach 0 ft. Fort +1, Ref +4, Will +1.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack or full attack. Gore +1 melee for 1d2 damage.
Enlarge (Su, 3/day). Become a Huge, 11-foot-tall construct for 1 minute. Use 55 HP, Fort +3, Ref +3 and Will +3. Use the elephant attacks below.
Trumpet (Su, 3/day). In either form, produce a 30-ft. cone as shout at caster level 8. It deals 5d6 sonic damage and deafens for 2d6 rounds. Fortitude DC 10 while small or DC 15 while enlarged halves damage and prevents deafness. Exposed brittle or crystalline things take 8d6 instead. Use the spell's normal saves for creatures and held objects. Silence blocks the cone.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Construct traits and damage reduction 5/—. Immune to cold and electricity. Follows direct, simple orders.

gm.title: Control

gm.title: Description
lines: Port Nyanzaru's merchant prince for plants, poisons, and sanctioned killings. She keeps her worsening death curse hidden beneath bandages.

gm.title: Hit point rule
lines: The listed dice are for the Assassin base. Jessamine starts the adventure with a maximum of 58 HP, down from the base average of 78.

gm.title: Languages
lines: Thieves' Cant and any two other languages.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Assassinate. On her first turn, Jessamine has advantage on attacks against creatures that have yet to act. A hit against a surprised creature is a critical hit.
Evasion. If a Dexterity save would let her take half damage, she takes none on a success and half on a failure.
Sneak Attack (once per turn). A weapon hit deals an extra 14 (4d6) damage if she attacks with advantage. She can also add this damage without advantage if she has no disadvantage and an ally who isn't incapacitated is within 5 ft. of the target.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Shortsword attacks.
Shortsword. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage. The target also makes a DC 15 Constitution save, taking 24 (7d6) poison damage on a failure or half on a success.
Light Crossbow. Ranged weapon attack, +6 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage. The target also makes a DC 15 Constitution save, taking 24 (7d6) poison damage on a failure or half on a success.

gm.title: Death curse
lines: Jessamine was restored to life years ago, so the Soulmonger reduces her maximum HP by 1 each midnight after the adventure begins. The loss cannot be restored while it is active. She dies at a maximum of 0 HP, and the curse traps her soul if she dies while the Soulmonger remains active.

gm.title: Encounter context
lines: Jessamine is inclined to help anyone trying to end the curse. At the council she speaks little and often breaks ties. She sells poisons at market price and controls the city's lawful writs for sanctioned killings.

gm.title: Printed source
lines: Tomb of Annihilation, ch. 1, p. 26, and Death Curse, p. 6. Use the Assassin from Monster Manual (2014), p. 343, with maximum HP reduced to 58 at the adventure's start.

Grinning Gaze (Sp). Anyone within 30 ft. subject to its gaze and able to hear the captain makes a DC 14 Will save or suffers Tasha’s hideous laughter at caster level 7.
Create Spawn (Su). A humanoid killed by the touch rises as a waterlogged zombie after 24 hours unless blessed and given a traditional burial at sea.

gm.title: Tactics

gm.title: Table notes

gm.title: Description
lines: This spiny sea dragon rises from frigid trenches to pull ships under. It sheds a poisonous film onto the surface of the water. Aboleths sometimes try to make servants of them.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Perception 12, Stealth 9. Resistant to bludgeoning damage. Immune to cold, poison, and psychic damage and to Charmed and Poisoned. Darkvision 120 ft. Understands Draconic and cannot speak.

gm.title: Ability modifiers
lines: Str +7, Dex -1, Con +9, Int -3, Wis +2, Cha -1

gm.title: Traits
lines: Poisonous Secretions. A creature that starts its turn within 10 ft. of the dragon, or within 30 ft. in water, takes 3 (1d6) poison damage.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make a Bite attack and a Tail attack, then use Constrict.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 15 ft. Hit 25 (4d8 + 7) piercing and 7 (2d6) poison damage.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 15 ft. Hit 21 (4d6 + 7) bludgeoning and 7 (2d6) poison damage.
Constrict. Target one visible Huge or smaller creature within 15 ft. It makes a DC 19 Strength save. Failure deals 21 (4d6 + 7) bludgeoning and 7 (2d6) poison damage, and leaves the target Grappled (escape DC 19) and Restrained until the grapple ends.

gm.title: Bonus Actions
lines: Glare of the Deep (2/day). Choose one creature the dragon can see within 60 ft. On a failed DC 14 Intelligence save, the creature takes 21 (6d6) psychic damage and is Charmed for 1 minute. While Charmed, it is Incapacitated, and on its turn moves by the most direct route to within 5 ft. of the dragon if farther away. It repeats the save before entering damaging terrain or when damaged by another source. Success ends the effect and grants immunity to this dragon’s Glare for 24 hours.

gm.title: Description
lines: The demon lord of oozes consumes living matter and turns it into more slime. Its many red eyes shift through a roiling body that can rise 20 feet above the ground.

gm.title: Damage immunities
lines: Acid, poison. Nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

gm.title: Condition immunities
lines: Blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, stunned, unconscious.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Foul. Any creature other than an Ooze that starts its turn within 10 ft. of Juiblex must pass a DC 21 Constitution save or be poisoned until the start of its next turn.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). When Juiblex fails a saving throw, it can spend a use to succeed instead.
Magic Resistance. Juiblex has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Regeneration. Juiblex regains 20 hit points at the start of its turn. Fire or radiant damage suppresses that recovery at the start of its next turn. It dies only if it starts a turn at 0 hit points and fails to regenerate.
Spider Climb. Juiblex climbs difficult surfaces and can move upside down on ceilings without an ability check.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make three Acid Lash attacks.
Acid Lash. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +14 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 60/120 ft., one target. A hit deals 21 (4d6 + 7) acid damage. A creature killed by this attack is pulled inside Juiblex and its corpse dissolves after 1 minute.
Eject Slime (Recharge 5–6). One visible creature within 60 ft. must succeed on a DC 21 Dexterity save or take 55 (10d10) acid damage. If the target takes any of this damage, any metal armor it wears suffers a permanent cumulative −1 penalty to the AC it grants. Any metal weapon the target carries or wears suffers a permanent cumulative −1 penalty to its damage rolls. An item is destroyed when its penalty reaches −5. Mending can remove the penalty on an object.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Wisdom (spell save DC 20) with no material components.
At will. Detect Magic.
3/day each. Contagion, Gaseous Form.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
Juiblex has 3 legendary actions and regains spent uses when its turn starts. It can use one option immediately after another creature’s turn, paying the listed cost. It must be able to take actions and cannot do so before the end of its own first turn if surprised.
Attack (1 action). Make one Acid Lash attack.
Corrupting Touch (2 actions). Melee weapon attack, +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. A hit deals 21 (4d6 + 7) poison damage and coats the target in slime. The target is poisoned until the slime is removed by spending an action to scrape it off. While the slime remains, any non-Ooze creature within 10 ft. of the target is poisoned.

gm.title: Lair
lines: Juiblex shares the Slime Pits of Shedaklah, a layer of the Abyss, with Zuggtmoy. In its lair, Juiblex is CR 24 (62,000 XP).

gm.title: Lair actions
lines:
At initiative count 20, losing ties, use one option while in the lair and able to take actions. If surprised, Juiblex must finish its first turn first. It cannot use the same option in consecutive rounds.
Green Slime. A patch of the Green Slime hazard appears on a ceiling spot Juiblex chooses in the lair and disintegrates after 1 hour.
Slippery Slime. Coat a visible square on the lair floor, up to 10 ft. on each side. A creature on the square when the slime appears, entering it for the first time on a turn, or ending its turn there must succeed on a DC 21 Dexterity save or fall prone and slide 10 ft. in a random direction (roll 1d8).
Sticky Slime. Coat a visible square on the lair floor, up to 10 ft. on each side. At the same three triggers, a creature must succeed on a DC 21 Strength save or be restrained while it remains in the area. It or another creature that can reach it can spend an action on a DC 21 Strength check, freeing it on a success.
Slippery and Sticky Slime last for 1 hour or until burned away. Burning slime disappears after 1 round and deals 22 (4d10) fire damage to creatures starting their turns in it.

gm.title: Regional effects
lines:
Acidic Water. Small bodies of water within 1 mile turn acidic and corrode objects that touch them.
Corrupted Nature. Within 6 miles, Wisdom (Medicine) and Wisdom (Survival) checks have disadvantage.
Slime. Within 6 miles, surfaces are frequently coated with a slick film that sticks to whatever touches it.
The region can show one or more effects. They fade over 1d10 days after Juiblex dies.

gm.title: Actions
lines:

Acid Lash. Melee weapon attack, +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 21 (4d6 + 7) acid damage. Juiblex draws in a creature this attack kills and destroys the corpse after 1 minute.
Eject Slime (Recharge 5–6). Pick one creature Juiblex can see within 60 ft. A failed DC 21 Dexterity save deals 55 (10d10) acid damage. If the target takes any of this damage, each metal armor piece it wears grants 1 less AC and each metal weapon it wears or carries takes a −1 penalty to damage rolls. These penalties are permanent and cumulative. An item is destroyed once its penalty reaches −5.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
Juiblex has 3 legendary actions and regains them at the start of its turn. Use only one option at a time, at the end of another creature's turn.
Acid Splash (1 action). Cast Acid Splash.
Attack (1 action). Make one Acid Lash attack.
Corrupting Touch (2 actions). Melee weapon attack, +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. A hit deals 21 (4d6 + 7) poison damage and coats the target in slime. The target is poisoned. Other creatures besides oozes are poisoned while within 10 ft. of the target. Scraping off the slime takes an action and ends both effects.

gm.title: Lair actions
lines:
On initiative count 20, after creatures tied on that count have acted, Juiblex may choose one option. It cannot use the same option in consecutive rounds.
Restraining slime. Coat a visible square of ground up to 10 ft. on each side. A creature there when the slime appears, entering it for the first time on a turn, or ending its turn there must pass a DC 21 Strength save or be restrained while in the area. The restrained creature or another creature within reach can spend an action to free it with a DC 21 Strength check.
Slippery slime. Coat a visible square of ground up to 10 ft. on each side. A creature there when the slime appears, entering it for the first time on a turn, or ending its turn there must pass a DC 21 Dexterity save or fall prone and slide 10 ft. in a random direction determined by a d8.
Either ground slime lasts 1 hour. Fire burns it away after 1 round. A creature starting its turn in burning slime takes 22 (4d10) fire damage.
Green Slime. A patch of Green Slime appears on a spot Juiblex chooses on the lair ceiling. It disintegrates after 1 hour.

gm.title: Regional effects
lines:
The region around Juiblex’s lair gains one or more of these effects.
Within 1 mile, small bodies of water become acidic and corrode objects that touch them. Within 6 miles, slick, sticky slime often coats surfaces.
A humanoid that spends at least 1 hour within 1 mile makes a DC 18 Wisdom save. On a failure, roll on Madness of Juiblex. A success gives 24 hours of immunity to that regional effect.
The regional effects fade over 1d10 days after Juiblex dies.

gm.title: Madness of Juiblex
lines:
If a creature goes mad in the lair or in Juiblex's line of sight, roll d100. The flaw lasts until cured.
01–20. The creature compulsively consumes everything it can.
21–40. It refuses to give up anything it owns.
41–60. It urges others to eat and drink past their usual limits.
61–80. It tries to acquire as many possessions as possible.
81–100. It judges its own worth entirely by what it consumes.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Mace. Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage. Priests bring the teachings of their gods to the common folk. They are the spiritual leaders of temples and shrines and often hold positions of influence in their communities. Evil priests might work openly under a tyrant, or they might be the leaders of religious sects hidden in the shadows of good society, overseeing depraved rites. A priest typically has one or more acolytes to help with religious ceremonies and other sacred duties.

gm.title: Description
lines: Kelek founded the League of Malevolence and wants to take Ringlerun’s Staff of Power. He makes a show of ruthlessness and falls back on magic when threatened.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Special Equipment. Kelek wears Bracers of Defense and starts with a fully charged Staff of Striking (10 charges). Each dawn, the staff regains 1d6 + 4 expended charges. When the last charge is spent, roll a d20. On a 1, it becomes an ordinary quarterstaff.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make three attacks using any combination of Sorcerer’s Bolt and Staff of Striking. Kelek can cast one spell from Spellcasting in place of one attack.
Sorcerer’s Bolt. Melee or ranged spell attack, +6 to hit, one target within reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. A hit deals 13 (2d12) force damage.
Staff of Striking. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, one target within reach 5 ft. A hit deals 8 (1d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage, or 9 (1d8 + 5) if wielded with two hands. On a hit, spend up to three charges to add 3 (1d6) force damage per charge.
Fiery Explosion (Recharge 4–6). Choose a point Kelek can see within 120 ft. The point erupts in magical fire. Every creature in a 20-ft.-radius sphere around it makes a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw. It takes 35 (10d6) fire damage on a failure, or half on a success.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:
As an action, cast one spell using Charisma (save DC 14).
At will. Light, Mage Hand, Prestidigitation.
1/day each. Dominate Beast, Fly, Mirror Image, Web.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Arcane Defense (3/day). When an attack hits Kelek, an invisible barrier adds 5 to his AC through the end of his next turn. Apply the bonus to the triggering attack as well.

gm.title: Combat notes
lines: Use Arcane Defense when Kelek’s low AC leaves him exposed. He uses Fiery Explosion whenever practical, even when allies are in the blast.

gm.title: Description
lines: This feathered tyrannosaur hunts the ruins of Omu. Huge tracks and long scarlet, orange, and green feathers mark its amphitheater lair.

gm.title: Hit point rule
lines: The adventure fixes the King of Feathers at 200 hit points and gives no replacement Hit Dice expression.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Detect Invisibility. The king sees invisible creatures and objects as though they were visible.
Legendary Resistance (3/Day). When the king fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

gm.title: Innate spellcasting
lines: The king can cast Misty Step at will as a bonus action. It uses Wisdom and needs no components.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and one Tail attack against different targets.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 33 (4d12 + 7) piercing damage. A Medium or smaller creature hit is grappled (escape DC 17) and restrained until the grapple ends. The king cannot bite another target while it holds that creature.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 20 (3d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage.
Summon Swarm (Recharge 5–6). If its jaws are free of grappled creatures, the king exhales a Swarm of Wasps into a space within 20 feet. The swarm is an ally, takes its turn immediately after the king, and disperses after 1 minute.

gm.title: Amphitheater
lines: When the party arrives, the king is home on a 50% roll by day or 25% at night. If it is out hunting, the chance it returns increases by 20 percentage points per hour. Five Deinonychuses prowl the ruin and attack on sight while the king is away. The king can also appear elsewhere in Omu, including during a rest or an ongoing fight.

gm.title: Printed source
lines: Tomb of Annihilation, chapter 3, p. 106 (area 13). Use the Tyrannosaurus Rex baseline in Monster Manual (2014), p. 80, with the printed changes above.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack. Unarmed strike +11 melee (1d3+4 lethal or nonlethal), katana +11 melee (1d10+4, threat 19–20), or mighty longbow +10 ranged (1d8+3, ×3 critical).
Full attack. One unarmed strike +11, katana +11/+6, or longbow +10/+5. Use the attack damage above.

gm.title: Supernatural abilities
lines:
Euphoria (Su). After at least a week of courtship and a successful Bluff (seduction) check, the woman makes a DC 20 Will save. Failure charms her as charm person (caster level 10th). She gains a +2 morale bonus on attack rolls and ability and skill checks near the kizoku, or takes a −2 morale penalty on those rolls when it is absent. This ends when the kizoku is destroyed or break enchantment dispels it.
Willow Heart (Su). After at least a month courting a euphoric woman and leading her to commit major betrayal or murder, the kizoku can offer a draining kiss. A failed DC 20 Will save lets it drain her life and turn her into a weeping willow as polymorph any object (caster level 10th). Ravenloft Innocents are immune to this death effect. While the kizoku lives, reversing the transformation leaves an inert body unless miracle, wish, or true resurrection restores the victim. After its death she can be restored normally, except that a victim whose tree provided the killing weapon still requires one of those three spells. The kizoku learns the languages spoken by those it drains and advances one Hit Die per four levels drained through this power.

gm.title: Spell-like abilities
lines: Caster level 10th, save DC 15 + spell level. At will: fly. 1/day each: alter self, calm emotions, charm person, color spray, command, confusion, crushing despair, daze, detect scrying, dimension door, disguise self, displacement, enthrall, gaseous form, hold person, hypnotism, invisibility, mind fog, mislead, rage, slow, and suggestion.

gm.title: Defenses and weakness
lines: DR 10/magic, low-light vision, regeneration 1, spell resistance 13. Its regeneration converts damage from ordinary attacks to nonlethal damage. Someone who truly loved a victim can identify her willow with a DC 20 Wisdom check. A weapon made from that willow’s heartwood deals lethal damage when used by that person. If they land the killing blow, the kizoku dies permanently and the stolen souls return to their owners. The kizoku normally tries to escape with its spells when threatened.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: The book gives no touch or flat-footed AC totals. Standard 3.5 defaults from the listed components are touch 13 and flat-footed 14 without applying Dodge. The full-attack line lists one unarmed strike despite the weapon attacks having iterative bonuses.

gm.title: Description
lines: A kobold that brings fragile improvised weapons into battle to injure, distract, or frighten opponents.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Pack Tactics. The inventor has advantage on an attack against a creature if a non-incapacitated ally is within 5 ft. of the target.
Sunlight Sensitivity. In sunlight, the inventor has disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks relying on sight.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
Sling. Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.
Weapon Invention. Choose an option or roll 1d8. Each option can be used at most once per day.
1. Acid. Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 5/20 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (2d6) acid damage.
2. Alchemist’s Fire. Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 5/20 ft., one target. On a hit, the target takes 2 (1d4) fire damage at the start of each of its turns until it spends an action and succeeds on a DC 10 Dexterity check to extinguish the flames.
3. Basket of Centipedes. Throw the basket into a 5-ft. square within 20 ft. A Swarm of Centipedes emerges with 11 hit points and rolls initiative. It has a 50 percent chance to disperse at the end of each of its turns.
4. Green Slime Pot. Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 5/20 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d10) acid damage and coats the target in slime, which deals 5 (1d10) acid damage at the start of each of its turns. A creature can use an action to scrape or wash the slime away.
5. Rot Grub Pot. Break the pot in a 5-ft. square within 20 ft. A Swarm of Rot Grubs emerges and remains a hazard in that space.
6. Scorpion on a Stick. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 1 piercing damage. The target then makes a DC 9 Constitution save and takes 4 (1d8) poison damage on a failure or half on a success.
7. Skunk in a Cage. Release a skunk in an unoccupied space within 5 ft. It has AC 10, 1 hit point, a walking speed of 20 ft., and no effective attacks. It rolls initiative and on its turn uses its action to spray a random creature within 5 ft. The creature must pass a DC 9 Constitution save or be incapacitated by retching for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. A creature that does not need to breathe or is immune to poison succeeds automatically. The skunk must finish a short or long rest before spraying again.
8. Wasp Nest in a Bag. Throw the bag into a 5-ft. square within 20 ft. A Swarm of Wasps emerges with 11 hit points and rolls initiative. It has a 50 percent chance to disperse at the end of each of its turns.

gm.title: MCDM minion rules
lines:
Minions of the same stat block normally share a turn and can all move before taking their actions. They use fixed damage, cannot score critical hits, and have no Hit Dice to spend.
A minion drops to 0 HP if an attack damages it or it takes damage from failing a save. Other damage kills it if the damage meets or exceeds its maximum HP. Otherwise the minion ignores that damage.
Overkill. When a weapon hit deals more damage than a minion’s maximum HP, apply the excess to an additional minion of the same stat block, as weapon attack damage. Repeat while damage remains after subtracting each target’s maximum HP. Melee targets must be within reach of the attack. Ranged targets must lie along the line of the attack and within the weapon’s normal range. Opportunity attacks cannot overkill.
Group attack. Two to five minions of the same stat block sharing a turn can each spend their action to make one attack if the target is within reach or range of each participant. Roll once, adding +1 for each participant, and multiply the fixed damage by that same count on a hit. Use advantage or disadvantage only if it applies to everyone in the group. Split groups when the target has different cover or concealment from different attackers.
A minion can make a group attack alone using its listed attack bonus and damage. If multiple eligible minions could make the same melee opportunity attack, they can each use their reaction to join one group attack. If the group attack triggers an effect against a single attacker, its target chooses which participating minion it affects.

lines: An undead cave hunter that steals breath. Ghouls sometimes follow it to feed on the bodies it leaves behind.

lines: Saves Dex +6, Con +6. Perception +4. Resists necrotic and poison damage and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from mundane attacks. gm.title: Traits
lines:
Breathless Aura. Enemies within 30 ft. cannot speak. Enemies in this area that need to breathe also have disadvantage on Constitution saves.
Wings of Breath. With at least one enemy within 30 ft., the koptourok has a flying speed equal to its walking speed. It falls if it starts its turn in the air without a flying speed.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Choking Grasp attacks.
Choking Grasp. Melee spell attack, +6 to hit, reach 30 ft., one creature. Hit 14 (4d6) bludgeoning damage. Pull the target to an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of the koptourok and Grapple it (escape DC 14). It stays Restrained while grappled, and this grapple does not halve the koptourok's speed.
Last Gasp. Each creature the koptourok is grappling must make a DC 14 Constitution save, taking 14 (4d6) bludgeoning damage on a failure or half as much on a success. The koptourok gains 5 temporary HP for each creature that failed.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Thunderous Deflation. When the koptourok drops to 30 HP or fewer, every creature within 30 ft. makes a DC 14 Constitution save. On a failure it takes 16 (3d10) thunder damage and is Deafened until the end of its next turn. On a success it takes half damage and avoids the condition. The koptourok then releases every creature it is grappling and flies up to its speed.

gm.title: Description
lines: A lightly built, winged reptilian warrior. Krolli settle in isolated eyries and sometimes travel to trade or take mercenary work.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Hill or mountain. Rare, active at any time. Omnivore. Intelligence 8–12. Treasure M, with A listed for the community. Any alignment. Appearing 1d20. No magic resistance. Height 7–8 feet, wingspan 17–20 feet. Elite morale 13–14.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Ground attacks. Make two claws for 1d8+1 each and a bite for 1d6+1.
Airborne attacks. Make two front claws for 1d8+1 each, one rear claw for 1d10, and a bite for 1d6+1. Krolli can use this sequence against targets on the ground.
Weapons. About 30% fight with weapons instead, and many carry shields.

gm.title: Flight and defenses
lines: The table lists AC 3 (2). Wings are AC 7. Frontal attackers can target the wings only if taller than the krolli, and rear attackers always roll against wing AC. A krolli that has lost at least half its HP cannot fly. It carries up to 30 pounds in flight unencumbered and up to 45 pounds encumbered. Save vs. paralyzation every 15 minutes of unencumbered flight or every 5 minutes when encumbered. On failure it must land and rest 1 hour per 15 minutes already flown.

gm.title: Group encounters
lines: An eyrie holds 3d20 adults, including one 7th-level fighter per 10 adults, and young with 1/2 HD equal to about one-tenth the adult count. gm.title: Red Curse and XP

gm.title: Table notes
lines: AC 2 is parenthetical in the table. The prose mentions shields without explicitly tying them to that number. The XP column prints an extra 650 with a Legacy without marking which tier it belongs to.

gm.title: Description
lines: An amphibious Underdark warrior with a net and an adhesive shield. Kuo-toa can bring deities into being through shared belief.

gm.title: Appearance
lines: A fishlike humanoid with bulging eyes and rubbery skin.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Amphibious. It breathes air and water.
Otherworldly Perception. It senses any Invisible creature or creature on the Ethereal Plane within 30 ft. It can pinpoint those that are moving.
Slippery. It has advantage on ability checks and saving throws to escape a grapple.
Sunlight Sensitivity. In sunlight it has disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that use sight.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage.
Spear. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit for 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage, or 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage with two hands in melee.
Net. Ranged weapon attack, +3 to hit, range 5/15 ft., one Large or smaller creature. A hit leaves the target Restrained. A creature can spend an action to free itself or another creature with a successful DC 10 Strength check. Dealing 5 slashing damage to the AC 10 net destroys it and frees the target unharmed.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Sticky Shield. When a creature misses the kuo-toa with a melee weapon attack, the kuo-toa catches the weapon with its shield. The attacker must succeed on a DC 11 Strength saving throw to keep the weapon from sticking. A stuck weapon is unusable. The wielder is Grappled while it is stuck if the wielder can't or won't release it. A creature can take an action and make a DC 11 Strength check to pull the weapon free.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: Spear uses the higher damage only in two-handed melee. Net attacks at +3, range 5/15 ft., and Restrain one Large or smaller creature on a hit. An action and a successful DC 10 Strength check free the creature. Dealing 5 slashing damage to the net (AC 10) destroys it and frees the target unharmed.

Attack. Claw +2 melee for 1d4 + 1 or sickle +2 melee for 1d6 + 1. Full attack makes two claws +2 melee for 1d4 + 1 each and a bite −3 melee for 1d3 + 1, or uses the sickle.
Detachable Limbs (Ex). It can remove or reattach any extremity unharmed as a standard action and still sense and control it when detached. Seeing it take off its head or use an arm as a club prompts a DC 15 Horror save except for the most callous witnesses.
Disguise Self (Sp). Twice per day at caster level 12, assume its appearance on the day it died. A free action maintains the disguise indefinitely. Magical or supernatural damage ends it immediately.
Create Spawn (Su). As a full-round action that provokes attacks of opportunity, breathe into the mouth of a dying humanoid below 0 HP as the target takes its last breath. Isolate the body for 72 hours. It rises as a lebendtod if left untouched, or as a ghast with none of its former abilities if disturbed but largely intact. Either serves the lebendtod’s master until that master dies.

gm.title: Adapting the encounter
lines: For a different humanoid base, keep its size, speed, base attack, saves, and skill points. Make it undead, convert Hit Dice to d12, add +2 natural armor, and add missing claw and bite attacks. Claw/bite base damage from Fine through Colossal: none/none, 1/none, 1d2/1, 1d3/1d2, 1d4/1d3, 1d6/1d4, 2d4/1d6, 2d6/1d8, 2d8/2d6. Use better existing damage. Str +2, Dex −2, Int −2. Remove Con. Add Iron Will and +5 racial bonuses to Bluff and Disguise. CR increases by 1. A clerical lebendtod rebukes instead of turning and cannot rebuke its master or the master’s other lebendtod.

gm.title: Description
lines: A banished tanar’ri posing as a red steel weapon. It steals Legacies through the wielder until it can return home.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Any terrain. Very rare, solitary, active at any time. Feeds on Legacies. Intelligence 19–20. No treasure. Chaotic evil. Appearing 1. Magic resistance 25%. True leech form is 7 feet long. Fearless morale 19–20.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Weapon form. The unattended leech moves and makes one attack each round using the damage of the weapon it resembles. Once held, it uses the wielder’s weapon abilities. It can appear as a +1 rapier, dagger, magical hook, or pistol. It may also let the wielder use an absorbed Legacy.

gm.title: Bond and theft
lines:
An intelligent creature that takes hold of the weapon is bonded as tendrils enter its flesh, with no save. The leech vanishes into its host until it reappears in one of its weapon shapes. The host drops anything held in that hand.
To steal a Legacy it does not have, the leech makes the host plunge its blade into the heart of a just-killed creature. The host can refuse a demand with a Wisdom check, blocking the leech for an hour or until a new conflict. During theft the host may save vs. spell to expel the leech, at −1 per Legacy it has absorbed. A host dies immediately once the leech steals 15 Legacies while bonded to that same host.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Starts with 1d4+1 acquired Legacies and never needs cinnabryl. Its weapon form radiates evil. A good priest’s grasp makes it wrench free at effective Strength 20. It will not choose a host with a heroic spirit. A paladin can still grasp it.

gm.title: Restored tanar’ri
lines: At 20 absorbed Legacies, the leech can break its banishment. It spends two rounds attacking those present before it automatically gates home. In this form it makes two claws for 4d4 each, casts as a 9th-level wizard, and is immune to cold, fire, electricity, poison, and charm.

gm.title: Appearance
lines: A goblin shrine keeper in filthy robes worn over leather armor.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Leather armor, shield. Skills Stealth +6. Senses: darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 9. Languages: Common, Goblin.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Scimitar. Melee weapon attack +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing.
Shortbow. Ranged weapon attack +4, range 80/320 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing.

gm.title: Bonus Actions
lines: Nimble Escape. Take the Disengage or Hide action.

gm.title: Encounter
lines: Lhupo wears filthy robes over his armor and claims to hear Maglubiyet. His two acolytes use the same ordinary Goblin attacks. If they heard fighting in the Dark Hall, they hide behind the altar and try to surprise intruders. Otherwise, they start the encounter kneeling at the altar. Lhupo's pet Grick waits in the Dark Hall.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: Rules source: Lost Mine of Phandelver, p. 39. The encounter gives this goblin 12 HP.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Saving Throws Con +10, Int +12, Wis +9 Skills Arcana +18, History +12, Insight +9, Perception +9 Damage Resistances cold, lightning, necrotic Damage Immunities poison; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks Condition Immunities charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned Senses truesight 120 ft., passive Perception 19 Languages Common plus up to five other languages

gm.title: Traits
lines: Legendary Resistance (3/Day). If the lich fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. Rejuvenation. If it has a phylactery, a destroyed lich gains a new body in 1d10 days, regaining all its hit points and becoming active again. The new body appears within 5 feet of the phylactery. Spellcasting. The lich is an 18th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 20, +12 to hit with spell attacks). The lich has the following wizard spells prepared: Cantrips (at will): mage hand, prestidigitation, ray of frost 1st level (4 slots): detect magic, magic missile, shield, thunderwave 2nd level (3 slots): acid arrow, detect thoughts, invisibility, mirror image 3rd level (3 slots): animate dead, counterspell, dispel magic, fireball 4th level (3 slots): blight, dimension door 5th level (3 slots): cloudkill, scrying 6th level (1 slot): disintegrate, globe of invulnerability 7th level (1 slot): finger of death, plane shift 8th level (1 slot): dominate monster, power word stun 9th level (1 slot): power word kill Turn Resistance. The lich has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Paralyzing Touch. Melee Spell Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 10 (3d6) cold damage. The target must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

gm.title: Legendary Actions
lines: The lich can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature’s turn. The lich regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn. Cantrip. The lich casts a cantrip. Paralyzing Touch (Costs 2 Actions). The lich uses its Paralyzing Touch. Frightening Gaze (Costs 2 Actions). The lich fixes its gaze on one creature it can see within 10 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw against this magic or become frightened for 1 minute. The frightened target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a target’s saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to the lich’s gaze for the next 24 hours. Disrupt Life (Costs 3 Actions). Each non-undead creature within 20 feet of the lich must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw against this magic, taking 21 (6d6) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Natural armor. Saving throws Str +11, Con +10, Wis +10, Cha +12. Arcana +11, Athletics +11, Deception +12, History +11, Perception +10, Stealth +9. Resists necrotic damage and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from mundane attacks. Immune to poison damage and to Charmed, Dazed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, and Stunned. Truesight 120 ft., passive Perception 20. Speaks Abyssal, Common, Draconic, and Infernal.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Rejuvenation. The destroyed lich takes refuge in its soulstone if it is intact. A creature that can see the occupied stone at the start of its turn must pass a DC 20 Charisma save or become Charmed by the stone until the end of its next turn. The Charmed creature tries its hardest to reach and touch the stone while avoiding obvious hazards. Any creature that touches the occupied stone makes a DC 20 Constitution save. On a failure, the toucher drops to 0 HP and the lich returns at full HP. On a success, the toucher loses half its current HP and the lich returns at half HP. Either way, the lich reforms in an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of the stone. The stone has AC 19, 50 HP, and immunity to every damage type except force and thunder.
Supernatural Resistance. The lich has advantage on saves against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.
Turn Immunity. Effects that turn Undead have no effect on the lich.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Use Glare of Undeath and make four attacks in any combination of Biting Acid, Disruptive Thunder, and Pain of Ages.
Biting Acid (3rd-level spell). Ranged spell attack, +12 to hit, 120-ft. range, one target. Hit 22 (5d8) acid damage. The target cannot regain HP until the start of the lich's next turn.
Disruptive Thunder (3rd-level spell). Melee or ranged spell attack, +12 to hit, 5-ft. reach or 60-ft. range, one target. Hit 22 (4d10) thunder damage. Move a Huge or smaller target up to 45 ft. horizontally.
Pain of Ages (3rd-level spell). Melee or ranged spell attack, +12 to hit, 5-ft. reach or 90-ft. range, one creature. Hit 21 (6d6) psychic damage. The first attack the target lands before the start of the lich's next turn deals half damage.
Glare of Undeath. One visible creature within 60 ft. makes a DC 20 Wisdom save. On failure it clutches itself and becomes Restrained for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns. A creature it hears and understands can use an action to end the effect with a successful DC 20 Charisma (Persuasion) check.
Horrid Woe (2/day). One visible creature within 90 ft. makes a DC 20 Constitution save, taking 61 (7d8 + 30) necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success. A target reduced to 0 HP becomes stable and cannot heal. Its spirit appears as a wraith in an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of the body. It obeys the lich's spoken commands and acts immediately after the lich on the same turn. When the lich or wraith is destroyed, the spirit returns to the body and the target can regain HP.
Life Absorption (1/day, 9th-level spell, concentration). Each enemy within 120 ft. makes a DC 20 Constitution save. On a failure, for 1 minute the enemy takes 16 (3d10) necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns. The lich gains temporary HP equal to the total damage dealt.

gm.title: Bonus Actions
lines: Necrotic Form (3rd-level spell). Become a shadow and move up to the lich's speed. In this form, the lich is immune to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage and to Grappled and Restrained, and can pass through gaps as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing. The form ends at the end of its turn.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Immortal Insight. When another visible creature rolls an attack, ability check, or saving throw, the lich can impose advantage or disadvantage.

gm.title: Utility Spells
lines: Charisma, spell save DC 20. At will: Arcane Lock, Charm Person, Detect Magic, Detect Thoughts, Disguise Self, Identify, Locate Object, Mage Hand. Three times per day each: Arcane Eye, Arcanist's Magic Aura, Contact Other Plane, Legend Lore, Scrying. Once per day each: Forbiddance, Geas, Hallow, Mirage Arcane, Symbol. Identify, Contact Other Plane, Legend Lore, Scrying, and the once-per-day spells use their listed casting times. The others take 1 action.

gm.title: Lair Actions
lines:
On initiative count 20, losing ties, choose one option. Do not repeat an option on consecutive rounds.
Soul Sip. Two visible enemies within 90 ft. each make a DC 20 Constitution save, taking 19 (3d12) necrotic damage on a failure.
Spirit Shell. Until the end of initiative count 20 on the next round, anyone who hits the lich with a melee attack must pass a DC 20 Wisdom save or be Dazed until the start of their next turn.
Unnatural Born Leader. One visible creature within 90 ft. makes a DC 20 Charisma save. On a failure, it uses its reaction, if available, to move up to its speed and make a weapon attack against a creature the lich chooses.

gm.title: Dazed (MCDM)
lines: On its turn, a Dazed creature chooses just one of moving, taking an action, or taking a bonus action. If the creature becomes Dazed during its turn, the turn ends. It still receives any extra actions granted by effects such as Haste or Action Surge. Cure Ailment, Lesser Restoration, or Greater Restoration can clear the condition.

gm.title: Description
lines: This undead hunter tracks prey from afar, then shifts between the Material and Ethereal Planes to close in.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Perception 14, or 19 by hearing or smell. Stealth 14. Vulnerable to bludgeoning damage. Resists piercing and slashing damage. Immune to poison damage, Exhaustion, and Poisoned. Darkvision 120 ft. Keensense 60 ft. Understands Common and Darakhul and cannot speak.

gm.title: Ability modifiers
lines: STR +0 · DEX +4 · CON +4 · INT -2 · WIS +0 · CHA +3

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Blood Sense. Smell pinpoints creatures within 60 ft. unless they are Constructs or Undead. Sense the direction of such prey out to 1 mile.
Heightened Hearing and Smell. Perception rises to 19 when relying on hearing or smell.
Undead Nature. Needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
Undead Resilience. Immune to poison damage, Exhaustion, and Poisoned.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Bite attacks. If both hit the same creature, it must make a DC 14 Constitution save or take 7 (2d6) slashing damage and be Incapacitated through the end of its next turn.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing plus 3 (1d6) necrotic damage. A creature must make a DC 14 Strength save or fall Prone.

gm.title: Bonus Actions
lines:
Eerie Howl. Each creature within 30 ft. makes a DC 14 Wisdom save or becomes Frightened for 1 minute. Targets repeat the save at the end of their turns. After a successful save or when the effect ends, that creature is immune to the hound’s howl for 24 hours.
Ethereal Jaunt. Magically shift between the Material and Ethereal Planes.

gm.title: Hit point rule
lines: 7 + 7 × the caregiver’s level in hit points, with one d8 Hit Die per caregiver level.

gm.title: Appearance
lines: A pale lionlike creature with an iridescent silver mane and two separate whip-like tails.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Natural armor 13 + PB. Strength save +3 + PB and Dexterity save +2 + PB. Perception +1 + PB and Stealth +2 + PB. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 11 + PB.

gm.title: Caregiver scaling
lines: PB is the caregiver’s proficiency bonus.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Signature Attack (Bite). Melee weapon attack at +3 + PB, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 1d6 + PB piercing damage.

gm.title: Ferocity actions
lines:
Level 1, Tail Whip (2 Ferocity). Make a signature attack. On a hit, add radiant damage equal to PB. A different creature of the lightbender’s choice within 15 ft. of the lightbender also takes radiant damage equal to PB.
Level 3, Silent Pounce (5 Ferocity). Teleport 30 ft. to a visible unoccupied space. The lightbender can make a signature attack before or after teleporting. On a hit, the target falls Prone.
Level 5, Hypnotic Mane (8 Ferocity). Every creature within 10 ft. makes a Wisdom save against DC 10 + PB or is Charmed by the lightbender until the end of the lightbender’s next turn. A creature Charmed this way is Incapacitated and its speed is 0. The effect on it also ends if it takes damage or another creature spends an action shaking it out of the stupor.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Shared Afterimage (long rest). When the lightbender or its caregiver is hit by an attack while they are within 30 ft. of each other, both are revealed as imprints. Each appears in an unoccupied space it can see within 30 ft. of its own imprint. The attack misses and the imprints disappear. This is unavailable against attackers that rely on senses other than sight, such as Blindsight, or can see through illusions, such as with Truesight.

gm.title: Mystic connection
lines: Unleash Sunlight. At 9th level, a Beastheart with this companion and Mystic Connection can spend a bonus action once per long rest to flash with bright light. Choose creatures within 10 ft. that can see the Beastheart. Each makes a Constitution save against the Beastheart’s exploit save DC or becomes Blinded for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns and ending the condition on a success.

gm.title: MCDM companion rules
lines:
Shared turn. The caregiver and companion act on the same turn. The companion moves and uses its reaction and bonus action independently. To do anything with its action besides Dash, Disengage or Dodge, it normally needs a command that costs the caregiver a bonus action. It must see or hear the caregiver. If the caregiver is Incapacitated, it can act without a command. The GM chooses who controls it when the caregiver is Incapacitated or absent.
Ferocity. At the start of their turn, unless Incapacitated, the companion gains 1d4 Ferocity plus one for each enemy it sees or hears within 5 ft. A swarm sharing one stat block counts as one enemy. Spend the listed cost before taking a Ferocity action. It uses the companion’s action, requires the listed caregiver level and is unavailable during a rampage.
Rampage. After rolling Ferocity, a companion with at least 10 Ferocity risks a rampage if it is not Incapacitated. A caregiver who is not Incapacitated and can be seen or heard can prevent it with a Wisdom (Animal Handling) check against DC 5 + Ferocity, without spending an action. If the companion rampages, it immediately moves toward the nearest creature it senses and makes its signature attack, with extra damage equal to half its Ferocity on a hit. If an ally and enemy tie for nearest, roll any die. On an odd roll the caregiver’s player chooses a tied ally. On an even roll they choose a tied enemy. If it cannot reach a target, it Dashes toward it. If it senses none, it moves as far as it can in a random safe direction. Ferocity falls to 0 after this action or at the end of the turn.
Recovery. At 0 HP, a companion makes death saves. After combat, Ferocity resets to 0. A companion that is not dying first regains HP equal to its remaining Ferocity.

gm.title: Heraldic servant rules
lines:
Printed source. Heraldic Servant, General, pp. 44–46.
A heraldic servant has an inactive form on its coat of arms and two active forms, one natural and one humanoid. The rightful bearer can summon one servant at any time. It must touch the coat of arms to return to it or transfer to another coat of arms.
Use the same hit points in either active form. Unless the entry gives an exception, use the same Armor Class and magical powers as well. Weapons and movement may depend on form. An active servant automatically defends its bearer unless ordered otherwise. It can only be killed while active.
An active servant and its bearer can share thoughts and senses telepathically within one mile. While linked, the bearer counts as one experience level higher and shares the servant's spell immunities and magic resistance. While the servant is inactive, personally carrying its coat of arms grants the extra level and magic resistance. Check the individual entry for additional benefits.
The servant's death removes all benefits and permanently costs its bearer two levels. The servant can return at the bearer's deathbed if a new generation takes over. Three consecutive unworthy generations lose its service until two consecutive generations prove worthy.
A heraldic servant needs neither food nor sleep and earns no XP. It remains neutral or takes its bearer's alignment. The Red Curse cannot give it Legacies or Affliction.

gm.title: Description
lines: A dream spirit bound to a living host. The six printed samples are companions of a 5th-level human fighter with 40 HP.

gm.title: Classification
lines: Construct; Medium incorporeal Dark Man shown in header

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Dark Man. Medium. Initiative +2, AC 13 (touch 12, flat-footed 11), BAB/grapple +3/+3, space/reach 5 ft./5 ft., Fort +1, Ref +3, Will +5. Attack or full attack is incorporeal touch +3 melee for 1d6 Strength damage. It fights as a shadow without creating spawn. Dodge. Hide, Listen, Spot and Survival each +8; Stealth adds +10 enhancement to Hide in shadows. Cooperation lends the host Hide while merged.
Living Spear. Medium object, 30 HP, hardness 5 or DR 10/magic, whichever applies; they do not stack. It cannot move independently. Use host BAB, attack and saves. Weapon damage 1d8 + 1. Dexterity 14, Int 4, Wis 14; no Str, Con or Cha. Guile can poison three penetrating attacks per day. Swiftness makes separation a free action and places it in the host’s hand.

gm.title: Traits
lines: All samples have 5d10 and 30 HP. Treat them as summoned creatures for XP; overcoming their host earns the award. All understand their host’s languages and have construct traits, DR 10/magic, Empathic Link, Merge and Life Bond. They cannot heal naturally or receive curing magic. A separated tattoo loses 1 HP per full 24 hours. A tattoo with an undead model cannot create spawn.

gm.title: Violet Panther
lines: Medium. Initiative +4, speed 40 ft., climb 20 ft., AC 15 (touch 14, flat-footed 11), BAB/grapple +3/+6, space/reach 5 ft./5 ft. Fort +3, Ref +7, Will +3. Str 16, Dex 19, Int 4, Wis 14, Cha 6. Claw +6 for 1d3 + 3; full attack two claws plus bite +1 for 1d6 + 3. Pounce, improved grab and rake 2d4 + 1 as a leopard. Scent, Stealth and darkvision 60 ft. Balance +12, Climb +11, Hide +9, Listen +7, Move Silently +9, Spot +7. Dodge and Weapon Finesse. It attacks without orders and must be told to stop.

gm.title: Grandfather Raven
lines: Tiny. Initiative +2, speed 10 ft., fly 40 ft. average, AC 14 (touch 14, flat-footed 12), BAB/grapple +3/−10, space 2½ ft., reach 0 ft. Fort +2, Ref +4, Will +2. Str 1, Dex 15, Int 4, Wis 14, Cha 6. Claw +4 for 1d2 − 5, two claws at full attack (minimum 1 damage on a hit). Listen +6, Spot +6, Weapon Finesse. Counsel grants discern lies and Worldliness grants tongues, each 1/day at CL 8.

gm.title: Winged Snake
lines: Small. Initiative +4, speed 40 ft., fly 100 ft. average, swim 40 ft., AC 15 (touch 11, flat-footed 15), BAB/grapple +3/+0, space/reach 5 ft./5 ft. Fort +4, Ref +4, Will +6. Str 13, Dex 10, Int 10, Wis 14, Cha 10. Claw +7 for 1d4; full attack two claws plus bite +2 for 1d6 + 1. Wyrmling green dragon breath: 20-ft. cone of acid for 2d6, DC 13 Reflex half. Guile applies to the bite. Electricity resistance 10, immune to acid, water breathing. Concentration +5, Diplomacy +5, Escape Artist +5, Listen +7, Search +5, Spot +7. Improved Initiative.

gm.title: Silver Wolf
lines: Medium. Initiative +2, speed 50 ft., AC 14 (touch 12, flat-footed 12), space/reach 5 ft./5 ft. Fort +3, Ref +5, Will +2. Str 13, Dex 15, Int 4, Wis 13, Cha 6. Bite +3 for 1d6 + 1 with wolf trip: a hit allows a free trip attempt without an initial touch attack, and failure allows no counter-trip. Scent; while merged the host may use the tattoo’s scent and Survival as listed. Hide +3, Listen +6, Move Silently +4, Spot +4, Survival +1. Weapon Finesse.

gm.title: Running the encounter
lines: Empathic Link is telepathy while touched or in line of sight. Merge or separate at will as a standard action; merging requires touch. While merged, damage to the host does not damage the tattoo. Attacks must specifically target the tattoo to harm it. Death of the host releases the spirit. Once per round as a free action the host can pay any number of their own HP to restore that many tattoo HP. The host recovers that loss only by natural healing. If the tattoo is destroyed, the host must make a Fortitude save at DC 10 + half tattoo HD or die. The site cannot hold another magic tattoo.

gm.title: Model abilities
lines: A host binds only one tattoo. The model must be no larger than the host and have fewer HD. Treat tattoo HD as the host’s level and HP as three-quarters of host HP rounded down. Keep model attacks and movement; objects cannot move on their own. Merged and object tattoos save as the host. Add two suitable powers: Caution, chosen energy resistance 10; Cooperation, one skill while merged; Counsel, discern lies 1/day; Excitement, +1d6 electricity on three attacks daily; Guile, three penetrating attacks daily poison at Fort DC 13 for initial 1d4 Str and secondary 1d4 Con; Mystery, blindness/deafness 1/day; Piety, prayer 1/day affecting tattoo and host; Stealth, +10 enhancement to Hide in shadows; Swiftness, free-action separation; Vigilance, darkvision 60 ft.; Worldliness, tongues 1/day. Use CL 8 for listed daily spell effects and DC 10 + tattoo Wis modifier + spell level.

gm.title: Bonding
lines: An Abber shaman’s rite takes 1d8 + 8 hours and deals 2d4 nonlethal damage to the host each hour. Afterward DC 14 Wisdom attracts a spirit. Bonding costs 200 XP per model HD, or 1/25 the object’s market price in XP with a minimum of 100 XP.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: The header uses the Dark Man example. The six forms do not have independent printed CRs. The source omits independent speed and AC for Living Spear and BAB/grapple for Silver Wolf. Use host rolls for Spear where directed.

lines: Initiative +0. AC −1 size, +5 natural. Touch AC 9, flat-footed AC 14. Base attack +6, grapple +10. Space 10 ft., reach 5 ft. Fort +2, Ref +2, Will +4.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack. Slam +10 melee (1d3 + 4) or short sword +10/+5 melee (1d6 + 4) in the printed examples. Full attack. Eight slams or eight short swords at the listed bonuses. Use the absorbed occupants to choose the wall’s real attacks.
Improved Grab (Ex) and Absorption (Su). Hit with an unarmed attack to attempt a grab, then pull the victim in. The victim must succeed on a Fortitude save, DC 10 + half the wall’s HD + its Strength modifier (DC 18 here), or be absorbed. Repeat each round the grapple continues. If the victim fails the save, allies trying to break the pin make the same save or are also absorbed. A creature killed or knocked unconscious within reach is absorbed on the wall’s next turn. True resurrection is the only way to restore an absorbed victim.
Animate Dead (Su). A corpse left within 300 ft. for a month becomes a zombie and walks into the wall. It never fights.
Spell-like abilities. An absorbed caster’s remaining spells become spell-like abilities, each usable once per day. The caster takes the wall’s alignment, which may remove class abilities.

gm.title: Gestalt Attacks (Ex)
lines: Each occupant adds its primary attack and keeps its base attack bonus. Use the higher of its Strength modifier and the wall’s, with no Dexterity modifier. Use +5 natural armor or the highest natural armor bonus among the occupants, whichever is higher. Magic equipment remains active, but bonuses of the same type do not stack. Magic weapons remain usable until their ammunition runs out. Ordinary objects fall to the foot of the wall.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Construct traits, spell resistance 14. Detect magic reveals its aura, true seeing pierces the false masonry, and seeing the true wall calls for a DC 20 Horror save. Within 15 ft., creatures can hear the voices. It speaks the languages of its occupants.
Insane (Ex). Mental contact calls for a Madness save, DC 10 + half the wall’s HD + its Wisdom modifier (DC 16 here). On a failure the DM chooses the derangement.
Magic Immunity (Su). Immune to flesh to stone and similar effects. Passwall and stone shape fail against its flesh. A caster using meld into stone on it is absorbed automatically.

gm.title: Encounter details
lines:
Solitary, on land or underground. Always chaotic evil. Double standard treasure. Feat: Multidexterity. The wall tries to absorb its creator. If it succeeds, it becomes ordinary stone and releases its souls.
It can absorb living creatures at least one size smaller. Add 1 HD for each Medium, two Small, four Tiny, or eight Diminutive creatures. Add 2 HD for a Large, 4 for a Huge, 8 for a Gargantuan, or 16 for a Colossal creature. It fills one 5-ft. cube per 3 HD, rounding down. The advancement lines give 9–15 HD (Large), 13–18 HD (Huge), and 19–26 HD (Gargantuan).

gm.title: Construction
lines: A 14th-level arcane caster needs at least three intact Medium humanoid corpses cemented into a 5-ft. cube, a DC 12 Craft (stoneworking) or Knowledge (engineering) check, 50,000 gp including 500 gp for the body, and 1,100 XP. The spells are animate dead, flesh to stone, limited wish, meld into stone, and stone to flesh. Prolonged deaths in a walled-up niche can also create one spontaneously.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: The example attack profile depends on the occupants. The printed advancement ranges overlap at 13–15 HD.
The entry describes both absorption on the next turn within reach and the separate month-long animation of corpses within 300 ft.

gm.title: MCDM minion rules
lines:
Minions of the same stat block normally share a turn and can all move before taking their actions. They use fixed damage, cannot score critical hits, and have no Hit Dice to spend.
A minion drops to 0 HP if an attack damages it or it takes damage from failing a save. Other damage kills it if the damage meets or exceeds its maximum HP. Otherwise the minion ignores that damage.
Overkill. When a weapon hit deals more damage than a minion’s maximum HP, apply the excess to an additional minion of the same stat block, as weapon attack damage. Repeat while damage remains after subtracting each target’s maximum HP. Melee targets must be within reach of the attack. Ranged targets must lie along the line of the attack and within the weapon’s normal range. Opportunity attacks cannot overkill.
Group attack. Two to five minions of the same stat block sharing a turn can each spend their action to make one attack if the target is within reach or range of each participant. Roll once, adding +1 for each participant, and multiply the fixed damage by that same count on a hit. Use advantage or disadvantage only if it applies to everyone in the group. Split groups when the target has different cover or concealment from different attackers.
A minion can make a group attack alone using its listed attack bonus and damage. If multiple eligible minions could make the same melee opportunity attack, they can each use their reaction to join one group attack. If the group attack triggers an effect against a single attacker, its target chooses which participating minion it affects.

lines:
Printed source. Lycanthrope, pp. 137 and 148.
Alternate Form (Su). Where available, take or leave an animal or hybrid form as a standard action. Equipment does not change. Entering either form heals as a day of rest. A slain lycanthrope returns to humanoid form where it has one, but severed parts keep their animal shape. An afflicted creature normally gains one alternate form and can struggle to control it.
Curse of Lycanthropy (Su). A qualifying bite to a humanoid within one size category requires Fortitude DC 18 or transmits the curse. Bludgeoning or nonpenetrating attacks cannot transmit it. Afflicted lycanthropes can spread it in Ravenloft. The general text specifies animal form, but a listed hybrid curse also uses this procedure at the table. Use any strain-specific exception below.
Natural lycanthropes generally have DR 10/silver in animal or hybrid form, while afflicted ones have DR 5/silver. Some strains name a different material. Low-light vision and scent work in any form unless the profile specifies otherwise. Lycanthropic empathy allows simple communication, gives a +4 racial bonus on attitude checks with the corresponding normal or dire animal, and permits simple commands to friendly animals.
A spellcaster cannot use verbal, somatic, or material components in animal form and cannot use verbal components in hybrid form. Apply the printed encounter stats for each form.

gm.title: Sacrament of the Falling Fire
lines: A one-hour ritual in the Deep Haze with a 30-ft. range. Each of up to 12 willing, faithful Humanoids drives a 100 gp delerium fragment into their chest, becoming sanctified. Each participant is then attacked by a hostile Shadow, or a Wraith if the GM judges the participant’s anger, fear, or hatred warrants one. While keeping the faith, a sanctified creature has advantage on saves against Charmed and Frightened, resistance to necrotic and radiant damage, and immunity to contamination. On death its soul enters the fragment and it cannot be raised while the soul remains there.

gm.title: Printed source
lines: Appendix B, pp. 216–217. Sacrament, Appendix D, p. 229.

gm.title: Delerium contamination
lines:
Printed source. Appendix C, pp. 222–223.
Add contamination levels from each exposure. A contaminated character rolls 1d20 at the end of each long rest and gains one level on a 1.
Symptoms are cumulative. Level 1 has no symptom. Level 2 halves healing from Hit Dice. Level 3 prevents HP recovery from a long rest. Level 4 halves damage the creature deals with weapon attacks and spells. Level 5 makes it Incapacitated. Level 6 triggers Monstrous Transformation.
After a character gains a level, roll 1d6. On a result at or below the current level, the GM chooses a new mutation or rolls on the printed mutations table. Replace or reroll duplicate mutations.
Contamination does not wear off. Purge Contamination can remove levels and causes Exhaustion. Heal removes all contamination and mutations. Each level removed also removes one random mutation. At level 0, all symptoms and mutations end.
A contaminated humanoid rises as a Haze Husk 24 hours after death. It rises as a Haze Wight if it had at least six class levels or Hit Dice. Raising a creature from the dead reduces its contamination by one level.
Monstrous Transformation. At level 6 or higher, the creature transforms after one round. Replace its statistics, hit points, and Hit Dice with those of a monster the GM chooses. Contamination resets to 0, and the GM controls the transformed creature.
Wish or similar magic can restore one transformed creature, clearing its madness and contamination. Using Wish this way gives the caster a 33 percent chance of losing the ability to cast it again.

lines: This web hunter grows stronger under a quarter or half moon and binds prey after landing both claws.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Natural armor. Perception 11. Stealth 17. Vulnerable to fire. Immune to poison damage and to Poisoned and Restrained. Darkvision 60 ft., keensense 10 ft. Speaks Deep Speech and Sylvan.

gm.title: Ability modifiers
lines: STR +0 · DEX +3 · CON +2 · INT +1 · WIS +1 · CHA +2

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Aberrant Resilience. Resistant to Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed, and Stunned. Advantage on saves against spells and effects that would change its form.
Spider Climb. Climb difficult surfaces and ceilings without an ability check.
Sunlight Sensitivity. In sunlight, attacks have disadvantage and sight-based Perception is 6.
Web Walker. Ignore movement restrictions from webbing.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and two Claw attacks. If both Claws hit one Medium or smaller creature, it can use Wrap Up on that creature.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 12 (2d8 + 3) necrotic damage. The target makes a DC 13 Constitution save. On a failure, reduce its HP maximum by the damage taken until it finishes a long rest. If its maximum reaches 0, it dies.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.
Wrap Up. Choose one Medium or smaller creature within 5 ft. It makes a DC 13 Strength save, with disadvantage if Restrained by webbing. On a failure it is wrapped, Blinded, Restrained, and unable to breathe until freed. At the start of each of the lunarchidna’s turns, the wrapped target makes a DC 13 Constitution save or takes 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage. Destroying the web frees the target (AC 13, 15 HP, vulnerable to fire damage and immune to bludgeoning, poison, and psychic damage). The lunarchidna can wrap only one creature at a time.

gm.title: Bonus Actions
lines:
Web (Recharge 4–6). Choose one visible creature within 30 ft. It makes a DC 13 Strength save or is Restrained by webbing. Any creature, including the target, may spend an action to free it with a successful DC 13 Strength check. The web can also be destroyed (AC 13, 15 HP, vulnerable to fire damage and immune to bludgeoning, poison, and psychic damage).
Shadow Stealth. In dim light or darkness, take the Hide action.

gm.title: Wishes
lines: Wishes are a power of exceptionally potent genies. Choose a limit of one to three wishes for this genie. The requester must be a non-genie creature within 60 ft. and state the desired effect to the genie. The genie can cast Wish on that creature's behalf. Once it grants its limit, choose how long before it can grant wishes again. A year is typical. The same genie can spend its entire allotment on a particular creature only once in that creature's lifetime. A genie may exploit loose wording to its own benefit.
