gm.title: Description
lines: This wasp-winged redcap stalks targets with illusions, needle daggers, and a grin that opens impossibly wide.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Initiative +5. AC 17 (+2 size, +5 Dex), touch 17, flat-footed 12. Base attack +2, grapple −8. Space 2½ ft., reach 0 ft. Fort +2, Ref +2, Will +5.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack or full attack. Bite +0 melee (1d4−2 plus poison) or powrie dagger +5 ranged (1d3−2).
Evil Grin (Su). A creature that looks at the grinning powrie makes a DC 16 Will save or suffers the fear spell.
Poison (Ex). The bite delivers injury poison. On a failed DC 15 Fortitude save, the victim is blinded as with blindness/deafness. There is no secondary damage.
Shriek (Sp). Creatures in a 30-ft. radius make a DC 15 Fortitude save or become deafened.
Alternate Form (Su). As a standard action at will, become a wasp or another stinging insect. Spend at most 3 hours in that form per 24 hours.

gm.title: Traits
lines: DR 5/magic and platinum. Immune to steel. Electricity resistance 10. Darkvision 120 ft. and low-light vision. Use the rogue rules for Evasion, Uncanny Dodge, Trapfinding, and Sneak Attack. Direct sunlight deals 1d4 damage each round without a save.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines: Casts Illusion spells as a 5th-level sorcerer. The book does not list spells known. For a quick encounter, select spells such as ghost sound, disguise self, silent image, invisibility, and mirror image. Spell save DC 11 + spell level.

gm.title: Skills and feats
lines: Disable Device +8, Hide +13, Move Silently +13, Open Lock +13, Search +8, Sleight of Hand +13. Dodge, Skill Focus (Hide). −10 racial penalty to Diplomacy. Speaks Sylvan.

gm.title: Encounter details
lines: Any land in the Shadow Rift. A lone powrie prefers surprise. Larger groups may attack directly. Solitary, a unit, or a hive of up to 400. No coins, 50% goods and 50% items. Always chaotic evil.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: The printed saves include Reflex +2 despite Dexterity 20. The stat block uses the printed save.
The book gives no Sneak Attack dice or Shriek duration. For play, use +3d6 Sneak Attack as a 5th-level rogue and let Shriek deafen for 1 round. These are table defaults.
The organization line prints ‘unit (46)’ without a separator. Use 4–6 for a small unit as a table default.

lines: Divine Eminence. As a bonus action, the priest can expend a spell slot to cause its melee weapon attacks to magically deal an extra 10 (3d6) radiant damage to a target on a hit. gm.title: Actions
lines: Mace. Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage. Priests bring the teachings of their gods to the common folk. They are the spiritual leaders of temples and shrines and often hold positions of influence in their communities. Evil priests might work openly under a tyrant, or they might be the leaders of religious sects hidden in the shadows of good society, overseeing depraved rites. A priest typically has one or more acolytes to help with religious ceremonies and other sacred duties.

gm.title: Description
lines: This shapeless mutant drags prey into its body and can climb across a ceiling.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Natural armor. Immune to Charmed, Frightened, and Prone. Blindsight 60 ft., passive Perception 10. No languages.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Absorption. When the abomination kills a creature other than a Construct or Undead, it absorbs the corpse and regains 20 HP.
Amorphous. Move through openings as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.
Spider Climb. Climb difficult surfaces and ceilings without a check.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Slam attacks. If both hit the same Large or smaller target, it is Grappled (escape DC 15) and the abomination uses Engulf on it.
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. Hit 19 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.
Engulf. Engulf one Large or smaller creature the abomination is grappling. Until the grapple ends, the target is Blinded, Restrained, and unable to breathe, and moves with the abomination. At the start of each of the abomination’s turns, the target makes a DC 15 Constitution save or takes 19 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. Only one creature can be engulfed at a time.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: The printed fixed damage for Slam and Engulf is 19. The same entries list a roll of 3d8 + 5.

lines: Sting · Melee basic attack with the Poison keyword.
Flyby Attack · At-will standard action. Fly up to 8 squares and make one melee basic attack along that route. Moving away from that target does not provoke its opportunity attacks.

lines: August 2012 update, p. 77, changes the original size from Tiny to Small. The checked Deluxe page already shows Small.
Unaligned. No languages. It communicates with animal noises. Wild pseudodragons hunt other creatures and usually leave humanoids alone unless provoked. Some live with humanoids as pets.
The tactics use Sting during a Flyby Attack when it is available. Against a persistent enemy the pseudodragon shifts, then uses Invisibility.

gm.title: Description
lines: A column of funeral flame scatters sparks from charred bones. It sets corpses alight and sends them careening through the fight.

lines: Medium Elemental (Fire, Mists). Medium size tier shown in header.

gm.title: Medium size tier
lines:
Medium elemental (Fire, Mists). CR 3. 26 HP (4d8 + 8). Initiative +7. Speed 50 ft..
AC 16, touch 13, flat-footed 13. Base attack +3, grapple +4. Space 5 ft., reach 5 ft.
Attack Slam +6 melee (1d6 + 1 plus 1d6 fire). Full attack Slam +6 melee (1d6 + 1 plus 1d6 fire).
Fort +3, Ref +7, Will +1. Str 12, Dex 17, Con 14, Int 5, Wis 11, Cha 11. Listen +5, Spot +5.
Feats include Improved Initiative, Weapon Finesse. Advancement 5–7 HD, Medium.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Slam. Make one melee slam, or use the full-attack count in the chosen tier. Each slam deals the indicated bludgeoning and fire damage.
Burn (Ex). A creature hit by the slam makes a Reflex save or burns for 1d4 rounds. Use DC 10 + half the elemental’s HD + its Dexterity modifier. A burning creature can put out the fire with a move action. A creature that hits the elemental with a natural weapon or unarmed strike first takes the slam’s fire damage, then makes the same save to avoid catching fire.
Dance of Death (Su). As a free action, touch a corpse of a formerly living corporeal creature within reach. It rises as a skeleton or zombie according to the corpse’s condition, rushes about attacking creatures and setting fires at random, and adds the effect of a direct hit with alchemist’s fire to its own attacks. That adds 1d6 fire on impact and another 1d6 the following round. A burning target can use a full-round action and a DC 15 Reflex save to extinguish it before that second damage roll. The animated body itself takes 1d3 fire each round until consumed.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Darkvision 60 ft. Immune to poison, sleep, paralysis, stunning, critical hits, and flanking. Does not eat, sleep, or breathe. It cannot be raised or resurrected, though limited wish, wish, miracle, or true resurrection can restore it. The fire subtype grants fire immunity and cold vulnerability, increasing cold damage by 50%. A pyre belonging to an exceptionally evil person can bring forth an elemental of the next larger size tier even if the caster cannot control it.

gm.title: Encounter details
lines: Solitary, always neutral evil, no treasure. May appear in any environment.

gm.title: Dread elemental rules
lines:
Printed source. Elemental, Dread, p. 63, and Mists subtype, pp. 7–8.
In Ravenloft, calling a standard elemental has a 20% chance of producing a dread elemental. Summoning magic always produces the dread form. Accidental dread elementals are uncontrolled, and the Dark Powers supply the matching materials. Intentional conjuring requires the matching material and uses the usual chance for the elemental to break control.
Dread elementals understand speech but do not communicate. Their Mists subtype makes them native throughout Ravenloft and allows them to be summoned in any domain. A dismissed dread elemental returns to Ravenloft itself, so the realm's restrictions on calling do not break the calling pact.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: Burn’s explicit DC formula uses Dexterity. The next sentence calls it Constitution-based. Use the explicit formula at the table. The DCs are 12, 15, 19, 25, 28, and 31 in size-tier order. Using Constitution instead gives 11, 14, 17, 22, 24, and 26.

Burn does not state ongoing damage. Use the core 3.5 catching-on-fire damage of 1d6 fire per round until the printed 1d4-round duration ends or the victim extinguishes it. The listed Greater slam damage of 1d8 + 7 is intentional here.

gm.title: Description
lines: A towering skeleton burns from within with blue fire. Its flames can shrink to a candle-sized flicker when it has stood idle for 48 hours.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Initiative +5. AC 16 (−1 size, +1 Dex, +6 natural), touch 10, flat-footed 15. Base attack +2, grapple +6. Space 5 ft., reach 10 ft. Fort +1, Ref +2, Will +4. Alertness, Improved Initiative. Any land or underground. Any organization. No treasure. Always neutral. Advancement 6–15 HD (Huge), 16–25 HD (Gargantuan).

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack. Claw +6 melee (1d6+4).
Full attack. Two claws +5 melee (1d6+4 each) or huge scythe +7 melee (2d6+6).
Fireball (Su), 1/hour. Cast an 8d6 fireball, Reflex DC 14 half.
Keen Edge (Su). Its flame applies keen edge to slashing weapons it holds. A nonmagical weapon it holds slowly becomes a huge bone scythe over a few months. This power leaves the claw attacks unchanged.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Undead traits. Immune to fire. DR 5/bludgeoning. Cold damage bypasses its DR. On a failed save against a cold-based effect, it takes half damage. It follows simple orders and cannot coordinate flanking.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: The printed 5-ft. space and +6 single claw versus +5 full-attack claws are retained. The cold rule specifies damage on a failed save only.
